 ─── Date Formatting Helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const formatDate = (dateStr string  Date) = {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  const day = d.getDate();
  const suffix =
    day === 1  day === 21  day === 31
       st
       day === 2  day === 22
         nd
         day === 3  day === 23
           rd
           th;
  const month = d.toLocaleString(default, { month long });
  return `${day}${suffix} ${month} ${d.getFullYear()}`;
};

type Chapter = {
  id string;
  title string;
  desc string;
  content unknown[];
};
type Section = {
  id string;
  title string;
  desc string;
  chapters Chapter[];
};
type Course = {
  id string;
  title string;
  category string;
  level string;
  status
     draft
     locked
     assets-uploaded
     model-trained
     test-generated
     ready-to-publish
     published;
  sections Section[];
  learners number;
  created string;
  tags string[];
  description string;
  prerequisites string[];
  pipelineStage number;  0=draft, 1=locked, 2=assets, 3=trained, 4=test, 5=published
};

 ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const F = Poppins, sans-serif;

function getInitials(name string) {
  return name
    .split( )
    .map((n) = n[0])
    .join()
    .slice(0, 2)
    .toUpperCase();
}

function batchBadge(status string) {
  bg string;
  color string;
} {
  switch (status) {
    case active
      return { bg #DCFCE7, color #16A34A };
    case completed
      return { bg #EFF6FF, color #2563EB };
    case closed
      return { bg #FEF2F2, color #DC2626 };
    default
      return { bg #F5F0EB, color #4A4A68 };
  }
}

function courseBadge(status string) {
  bg string;
  color string;
} {
  switch (status) {
    case uploaded
      return { bg #DCFCE7, color #16A34A };
    case draft
      return { bg #FEF3C7, color #D97706 };
    case locked
      return { bg #F1F5F9, color #64748B };
    default
      return { bg #F5F0EB, color #4A4A68 };
  }
}

function notifIcon(type string) {
  switch (type) {
    case batch
      return httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48group.png;
    case course
      return httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48online-learning.png;
    case test
      return httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48test-passed.png;
    case supervisor
      return httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48manager.png;
    default
      return httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48feedback.png;
  }
}

function notifBg(type string) {
  switch (type) {
    case batch
      return #EFF6FF;
    case course
      return #FFF3EE;
    case test
      return #F0FDF4;
    case supervisor
      return #FAF5FF;
    default
      return #F5F0EB;
  }
}

interface StatCardProps {
  icon string;
  value number;
  label string;
  trend string;
  trendUp boolean;
  accentColor string;
  bgGradient string;
}

function StatCard({
  icon,
  value,
  label,
  trend,
  trendUp,
  accentColor,
  bgGradient,
} StatCardProps) {
  const [display, setDisplay] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() = {
    let current = 0;
    const step = value  50;
    const timer = setInterval(() = {
      current += step;
      if (current = value) {
        setDisplay(value);
        clearInterval(timer);
      } else {
        setDisplay(Math.round(current));
      }
    }, 20);
    return () = clearInterval(timer);
  }, [value]);

  return (
    div
      style={{
        background bgGradient,
        border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
        borderRadius 16,
        padding 16px 20px,
        position relative,
        overflow hidden,
        boxShadow 0 2px 8px rgba(26,26,46,0.06),
        height 100,
      }}
    
      div
        style={{
          position absolute,
          top 0,
          left 0,
          right 0,
          height 3,
          background accentColor,
          borderRadius 16px 16px 0 0,
        }}
      
      div
        style={{
          display flex,
          justifyContent space-between,
          alignItems flex-start,
          marginBottom 8,
        }}
      
        img
          src={icon}
          width={28}
          height={28}
          alt=
          style={{
            background transparent,
            filter drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)),
          }}
        
        span
          style={{
            background trendUp  #DCFCE7  #FEF2F2,
            color trendUp  #16A34A  #DC2626,
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 11,
            fontWeight 600,
            borderRadius 9999,
            padding 2px 8px,
          }}
        
          {trend}
        span
      div
      div
        style={{
          fontFamily F,
          fontSize 26,
          fontWeight 700,
          color #1A1A2E,
          lineHeight 1,
        }}
      
        {display}
      div
      div
        style={{
          fontFamily F,
          fontSize 11,
          fontWeight 600,
          color #9898B0,
          letterSpacing 0.6px,
          marginTop 3,
          textTransform uppercase,
        }}
      
        {label}
      div
    div
  );
}

 ─── PlaceholderScreen ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function PlaceholderScreen({
  title,
  icon,
  onBack,
} {
  title string;
  icon string;
  onBack () = void;
}) {
  return (
    div
      style={{
        height calc(100vh - 56px),
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        alignItems center,
        justifyContent center,
        background #FDF8F4,
        gap 16,
      }}
      className=screen-enter
    
      img
        src={icon}
        width={80}
        height={80}
        alt=
        style={{ background transparent, opacity 0.6 }}
      
      div
        style={{
          fontFamily F,
          fontSize 20,
          fontWeight 600,
          color #1A1A2E,
        }}
      
        {title}
      div
      div
        style={{
          fontFamily F,
          fontSize 14,
          color #9898B0,
        }}
      
        Coming in the next step
      div
      button
        onClick={onBack}
        style={{
          background #BD1313,
          color white,
          border none,
          borderRadius 10,
          padding 10px 20px,
          cursor pointer,
          fontFamily F,
          fontSize 14,
          fontWeight 600,
          marginTop 8,
        }}
      
        ← Back to Dashboard
      button
    div
  );
}

 ─── Course Helper Components ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function Badge({ status } { status string }) {
  const s =
    STATUS_STYLES[status] 
    STATUS_COLORS[status] 
    STATUS_COLORS.draft;
  return (
    span
      style={{
        background s.bg,
        color s.color,
        border `1px solid ${s.border}`,
        borderRadius 6,
        padding 3px 8px,
        fontSize 11,
        fontWeight 600,
        display inline-block,
      }}
    
      {s.label}
    span
  );
}

function LevelChip({ level } { level string }) {
  return (
    span
      style={{
        background #FDF8F4,
        color #6B6B8A,
        border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
        borderRadius 9999,
        padding 2px 10px,
        fontSize 11,
        fontWeight 500,
      }}
    
      {level}
    span
  );
}

function ActionBtn({
  icon,
  onClick,
  hoverBg,
  hoverColor,
} {
  icon React.ReactNode;
  onClick (e React.MouseEvent) = void;
  hoverBg string;
  hoverColor string;
}) {
  const [hov, setHov] = useState(false);
  return (
    button
      onClick={onClick}
      onMouseEnter={() = setHov(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() = setHov(false)}
      style={{
        width 28,
        height 28,
        borderRadius 8,
        border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
        background hov  hoverBg  white,
        cursor pointer,
        display flex,
        alignItems center,
        justifyContent center,
        transition all 0.2s,
        color hov  hoverColor  #4A4A68,
      }}
    
      {icon}
    button
  );

function StepIndicator({
  steps,
  current,
} {
  steps string[];
  current number;
}) {
  return (
    div
      style={{
        display flex,
        alignItems center,
        gap 0,
        padding 0 8px,
      }}
    
      {steps.map((step, i) = {
        const done = i  current;
        const active = i === current;
        return (
          div
            key={i}
            style={{
              display flex,
              alignItems center,
              flex i  steps.length - 1  1  auto,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                display flex,
                flexDirection column,
                alignItems center,
                gap 6,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  width 32,
                  height 32,
                  borderRadius 50%,
                  display flex,
                  alignItems center,
                  justifyContent center,
                  background done
                     #16A34A
                     active
                       #BD1313
                       #F5F0EB,
                  color done  active  white  #9898B0,
                  fontSize 13,
                  fontWeight 700,
                  boxShadow active
                     0 2px 8px rgba(189,19,19,0.3)
                     none,
                  transition all 0.3s,
                  flexShrink 0,
                }}
              
                {done  Check size={14}   i + 1}
              div
              span
                style={{
                  fontSize 11,
                  fontWeight 500,
                  color done
                     #16A34A
                     active
                       #BD1313
                       #9898B0,
                  whiteSpace nowrap,
                }}
              
                {step}
              span
            div
            {i  steps.length - 1 && (
              div
                style={{
                  height 2,
                  flex 1,
                  background done  #16A34A  #EEE8E3,
                  margin 0 8px,
                  marginBottom 18,
                  transition background 0.3s,
                }}
              
            )}
          div
        );
      })}
    div
  );
}

function CourseInput({
  label,
  placeholder,
  value,
  onChange,
  icon,
  type = text,
  required = false,
  textarea = false,
  rows = 3,
} {
  label string;
  placeholder string;
  value string;
  onChange (
    e React.ChangeEvent
      HTMLInputElement  HTMLTextAreaElement
    ,
  ) = void;
  icon React.ReactNode;
  type string;
  required boolean;
  textarea boolean;
  rows number;
}) {
  return (
    div
      style={{
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        gap 6,
      }}
    
      {label && (
        label
          style={{
            fontSize 11,
            fontWeight 600,
            color #6B6B8A,
            textTransform uppercase as const,
            letterSpacing 0.8px,
          }}
        
          {label}
          {required && (
            span style={{ color #BD1313, marginLeft 2 }}
              
            span
          )}
        label
      )}
      div
        style={{
          position relative,
          display flex,
          alignItems textarea  flex-start  center,
        }}
      
        {icon && (
          div
            style={{
              position absolute,
              left 12,
              top textarea  12  50%,
              transform textarea  none  translateY(-50%),
              color #9898B0,
              display flex,
              pointerEvents none as const,
            }}
          
            {icon}
          div
        )}
        {textarea  (
          textarea
            value={value}
            onChange={
              onChange as React.ChangeEventHandlerHTMLTextAreaElement
            }
            placeholder={placeholder}
            rows={rows}
            style={{
              width 100%,
              padding icon
                 12px 14px 12px 38px
                 12px 14px,
              border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
              borderRadius 10,
              fontSize 14,
              color #1A1A2E,
              background white,
              outline none,
              resize vertical as const,
              lineHeight 1.6,
              fontFamily F,
              minHeight 80,
            }}
            onFocus={(e) =
              (e.target.style.borderColor = #BD1313)
            }
            onBlur={(e) =
              (e.target.style.borderColor = #EEE8E3)
            }
          
        )  (
          input
            type={type}
            value={value}
            onChange={
              onChange as React.ChangeEventHandlerHTMLInputElement
            }
            placeholder={placeholder}
            style={{
              width 100%,
              height 44,
              padding icon  0 14px 0 38px  0 14px,
              border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
              borderRadius 10,
              fontSize 14,
              color #1A1A2E,
              background white,
              outline none,
              fontFamily F,
            }}
            onFocus={(e) =
              (e.target.style.borderColor = #BD1313)
            }
            onBlur={(e) =
              (e.target.style.borderColor = #EEE8E3)
            }
          
        )}
      div
    div
  );
}

function CourseSelect({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  options,
  placeholder,
  required = false,
} {
  label string;
  value string;
  onChange (e React.ChangeEventHTMLSelectElement) = void;
  options string[];
  placeholder string;
  required boolean;
}) {
  return (
    div
      style={{
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        gap 6,
      }}
    
      {label && (
        label
          style={{
            fontSize 11,
            fontWeight 600,
            color #6B6B8A,
            textTransform uppercase as const,
            letterSpacing 0.8px,
          }}
        
          {label}
          {required && (
            span style={{ color #BD1313, marginLeft 2 }}
              
            span
          )}
        label
      )}
      div style={{ position relative }}
        select
          value={value}
          onChange={onChange}
          style={{
            width 100%,
            height 44,
            padding 0 36px 0 14px,
            border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
            borderRadius 10,
            fontSize 14,
            color value  #1A1A2E  #9898B0,
            background white,
            outline none,
            cursor pointer,
            appearance none as const,
            fontFamily F,
          }}
          onFocus={(e) =
            (e.target.style.borderColor = #BD1313)
          }
          onBlur={(e) =
            (e.target.style.borderColor = #EEE8E3)
          }
        
          {placeholder && (
            option value={placeholder}option
          )}
          {options.map((o) = (
            option key={o} value={o}
              {o}
            option
          ))}
        select
        ChevronDown
          size={16}
          style={{
            position absolute,
            right 12,
            top 50%,
            transform translateY(-50%),
            color #9898B0,
            pointerEvents none as const,
          }}
        
      div
    div
  );
}

 ─── Custom Charts (replaces Recharts to avoid internal SVG key collisions) ───

function CustomBarChart({
  data,
} {
  data { month string; batches number }[];
}) {
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() = {
    const t = setTimeout(() = setReady(true), 60);
    return () = clearTimeout(t);
  }, []);
  const max = Math.max(...data.map((d) = d.batches));
  const gridLines = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
  return (
    div
      style={{
        position relative,
        height 160,
        padding 0 4px,
      }}
    
      { Gridlines }
      div
        style={{
          position absolute,
          inset 0,
          bottom 24,
          top 4,
          display flex,
          flexDirection column,
          justifyContent space-between,
          pointerEvents none,
        }}
      
        {gridLines.reverse().map((n) = (
          div
            key={n}
            style={{
              borderTop 1px dashed #F5F0EB,
              width 100%,
            }}
          
        ))}
      div
      { Bars }
      div
        style={{
          display flex,
          alignItems flex-end,
          gap 6,
          height 100%,
          paddingBottom 24,
          paddingTop 4,
          position relative,
        }}
      
        {data.map((item) = (
          div
            key={item.month}
            style={{
              flex 1,
              display flex,
              flexDirection column,
              alignItems center,
              gap 4,
              height 100%,
              justifyContent flex-end,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                width 70%,
                maxWidth 32,
                height ready
                   `${(item.batches  max)  100}%`
                   0%,
                background #BD1313,
                borderRadius 4px 4px 0 0,
                transition
                  height 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.2,0.64,1),
                minWidth 16,
              }}
            
          div
        ))}
      div
      { X-axis labels }
      div
        style={{
          position absolute,
          bottom 0,
          left 4,
          right 4,
          display flex,
          gap 6,
        }}
      
        {data.map((item) = (
          div
            key={item.month}
            style={{
              flex 1,
              textAlign center,
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 11,
              color #9898B0,
            }}
          
            {item.month}
          div
        ))}
      div
    div
  );
}

function CustomDonut({
  data,
  id,
} {
  data { name string; value number; color string }[];
  id string;
}) {
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() = {
    const t = setTimeout(() = setReady(true), 60);
    return () = clearTimeout(t);
  }, []);
  const total = data.reduce((sum, d) = sum + d.value, 0);
  const size = 120;
  const cx = size  2;
  const cy = size  2;
  const r = 43;
  const strokeWidth = 16;
  const C = 2  Math.PI  r;
  const gap = 3;
  let offset = 0;
  const segments = data.map((d) = {
    const seg = (d.value  total)  C;
    const visible = Math.max(0, seg - gap);
    const dashArray = `${ready  visible  0} ${C}`;
    const dashOffset = -offset;
    offset += seg;
    return { ...d, dashArray, dashOffset };
  });
  return (
    svg
      width={size}
      height={size}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}
      aria-label={id}
    
      circle
        cx={cx}
        cy={cy}
        r={r}
        fill=none
        stroke=#F5F0EB
        strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      
      {segments.map((seg) = (
        circle
          key={`${id}-${seg.name}`}
          cx={cx}
          cy={cy}
          r={r}
          fill=none
          stroke={seg.color}
          strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
          strokeDasharray={seg.dashArray}
          strokeDashoffset={seg.dashOffset}
          strokeLinecap=butt
          transform={`rotate(-90 ${cx} ${cy})`}
          style={{ transition stroke-dasharray 0.9s ease }}
        
      ))}
    svg
  );
}

function CustomHBar({
  data,
} {
  data { type string; count number; color string }[];
}) {
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() = {
    const t = setTimeout(() = setReady(true), 60);
    return () = clearTimeout(t);
  }, []);
  const max = Math.max(...data.map((d) = d.count));
  return (
    div
      style={{
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        gap 14,
        padding 8px 0,
      }}
    
      {data.map((item) = (
        div
          key={item.type}
          style={{
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            gap 10,
          }}
        
          span
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 12,
              color #6B6B8A,
              width 78,
              flexShrink 0,
            }}
          
            {item.type}
          span
          div
            style={{
              flex 1,
              height 22,
              background #F5F0EB,
              borderRadius 6,
              overflow hidden,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                width ready
                   `${(item.count  max)  100}%`
                   0%,
                height 100%,
                background item.color,
                borderRadius 6,
                transition
                  width 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.2,0.64,1),
              }}
            
          div
          span
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 13,
              fontWeight 600,
              color #1A1A2E,
              width 28,
              textAlign right,
              flexShrink 0,
            }}
          
            {item.count}
          span
        div
      ))}
    div
  );
}

 ─── SupervisorScreen ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Supervisor = (typeof supervisorsList)[number] & {
  status string;
};

function SupervisorScreen({
  showToast,
} {
  showToast (msg string, type string) = void;
}) {
  const [supList, setSupList] = useStateSupervisor[](
    supervisorsList as Supervisor[],
  );
  const [supSearch, setSupSearch] = useState();
  const [supRoleFilter, setSupRoleFilter] = useState(All);
  const [supDeptFilter, setSupDeptFilter] = useState(All);
  const [supStatusFilter, setSupStatusFilter] = useState(All);
  const [showAddSupervisor, setShowAddSupervisor] =
    useState(false);
  const [selectedSupervisor, setSelectedSupervisor] =
    useStateSupervisor  null(null);
  const [newSupervisor, setNewSupervisor] = useState({
    name ,
    email ,
    phone ,
    role ,
    dept ,
  });
  const [rowHover, setRowHover] = useStatestring  null(null);
  const searchRef = useRefHTMLInputElement(null);

  const filteredSupervisors = supList.filter((s) = {
    const q = supSearch.toLowerCase();
    const matchSearch =
      q ===  
      s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) 
      s.email.toLowerCase().includes(q) 
      s.id.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    const matchRole =
      supRoleFilter === All  s.role === supRoleFilter;
    const matchDept =
      supDeptFilter === All  s.dept === supDeptFilter;
    const matchStatus =
      supStatusFilter === All  s.status === supStatusFilter;
    return matchSearch && matchRole && matchDept && matchStatus;
  });

  const activeCount = supList.filter(
    (s) = s.status === active,
  ).length;
  const inactiveCount = supList.filter(
    (s) = s.status === inactive,
  ).length;
  const totalAssignments = supList.reduce(
    (sum, s) = sum + s.assignedBatches,
    0,
  );

  const clearFilters = () = {
    setSupSearch();
    setSupRoleFilter(All);
    setSupDeptFilter(All);
    setSupStatusFilter(All);
  };

  const toggleStatus = (
    id string,
    name string,
    currentStatus string,
  ) = {
    setSupList((prev) =
      prev.map((s) =
        s.id === id
           {
              ...s,
              status
                currentStatus === active
                   inactive
                   active,
            }
           s,
      ),
    );
    setTimeout(
      () =
        showToast(
          name +
            (currentStatus === active
                deactivated
                activated),
        ),
      0,
    );
  };

  const inputStyle React.CSSProperties = {
    height 44,
    padding 0 14px,
    background white,
    border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
    borderRadius 10,
    fontFamily F,
    fontSize 14,
    color #1A1A2E,
    outline none,
    width 100%,
  };

  const selectStyle React.CSSProperties = {
    ...inputStyle,
    cursor pointer,
    appearance none as const,
  };

  const labelStyle React.CSSProperties = {
    fontFamily F,
    fontSize 11,
    fontWeight 600,
    color #6B6B8A,
    textTransform uppercase,
    letterSpacing 0.8px,
    marginBottom 6,
    display block,
  };

  return (
    div
      style={{
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        height calc(100vh - 56px),
        overflow hidden,
        background #FDF8F4,
      }}
      className=screen-enter
    
      { ── Top Stats Bar ── }
      div
        style={{
          height 80,
          flexShrink 0,
          background white,
          borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          padding 0 24px,
          display flex,
          alignItems center,
          gap 0,
        }}
      
        {[
          {
            dot #16A34A,
            value activeCount,
            label Active Supervisors,
          },
          {
            dot #DC2626,
            value inactiveCount,
            label Inactive,
          },
          {
            dot #BD1313,
            value supList.length,
            label Total Supervisors,
          },
          {
            dot #2563EB,
            value totalAssignments,
            label Total Assignments,
          },
        ].map((stat, i, arr) = (
          div
            key={stat.label}
            style={{
              display flex,
              alignItems center,
              gap 8,
              padding 0 24px,
              borderRight
                i  arr.length - 1
                   1px solid #EEE8E3
                   none,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                width 8,
                height 8,
                borderRadius 50%,
                background stat.dot,
                flexShrink 0,
              }}
            
            div
              div
                style={{
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 22,
                  fontWeight 700,
                  color #1A1A2E,
                  lineHeight 1,
                }}
              
                {stat.value}
              div
              div
                style={{
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 11,
                  fontWeight 500,
                  color #9898B0,
                  marginTop 3,
                }}
              
                {stat.label}
              div
            div
          div
        ))}
        div style={{ marginLeft auto }}
          button
            onClick={() = setShowAddSupervisor(true)}
            style={{
              height 44,
              padding 0 20px,
              background #BD1313,
              color white,
              border none,
              borderRadius 10,
              cursor pointer,
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 14,
              fontWeight 600,
              display flex,
              alignItems center,
              gap 8,
              transition all 0.2s,
            }}
          
            Plus size={18} color=white 
            Add Supervisor
          button
        div
      div

      { ── Filter Bar ── }
      div
        style={{
          height 56,
          flexShrink 0,

          borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,

        }}
      
        { Search }
        div
          style={{

            size={15}

                }}
              

              { Activity }

                    marginBottom 10,
                  }}
                
                  Recent Activity
                div
                {[
                  {
                    title Assigned to React Batch 2025-A,
                    time 3 days ago,
                    color #16A34A,
                  },
                  {
                    title Completed Python DS content review,
                    time 1 week ago,
                    color #2563EB,
                  },
                  {
                    title Added as supervisor,

                    color #BD1313,
                  },
                ].map((item) = (
                  div
                    key={item.title}
                    style={{

                      gap 8,

                    }}

                flexShrink 0,
              }}
            
              button
                onClick={() =
                  setTimeout(
                    () =
                      showToast(Edit supervisor coming soon!),
                    0,
                  )
                }
                style={{
                  flex 1,
                  height 40,
                  background transparent,
                  border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
                  color #4A4A68,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 13,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  borderRadius 8,
                  cursor pointer,
                }}
              
                Edit Details
              button
              button
                onClick={() = {
                  const newStatus =
                    selectedSupervisor.status === active
                       inactive
                       active;
                  setSupList((prev) =
                    prev.map((s) =
                      s.id === selectedSupervisor.id
                         { ...s, status newStatus }
                         s,
                    ),
                  );
                  setSelectedSupervisor((prev) =
                    prev
                       { ...prev, status newStatus }
                       null,
                  );
                  setTimeout(
                    () =
                      showToast(
                        selectedSupervisor.name +
                          (selectedSupervisor.status ===
                          active
                              deactivated
                              activated),
                      ),
                    0,
                  );
                }}
                style={{
                  flex 1,
                  height 40,
                  background
                    selectedSupervisor.status === active
                       #FEF2F2
                       #DCFCE7,
                  color
                    selectedSupervisor.status === active
                       #DC2626
                       #16A34A,
                  border
                    selectedSupervisor.status === active
                       1px solid #FECACA
                       1px solid #86EFAC,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 13,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  borderRadius 8,
                  cursor pointer,
                }}
              
                {selectedSupervisor.status === active
                   Deactivate
                   Activate}
              button
            div
          div
        
      )}
    div
  );
}

 ─── Pipeline Progress Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function PipelineProgress({ stage } { stage number }) {
  const stages = [
    { label Draft, id 0 },
    { label Locked, id 1 },
    { label Assets, id 2 },
    { label Trained, id 3 },
    { label Test, id 4 },
    { label Published, id 5 },
  ];

  return (
    div
      style={{ display flex, alignItems center, gap 4 }}
    
      {stages.map((s, i) = (
        div
          key={s.id}
          style={{
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            flex i  stages.length - 1  1  0,
          }}
        
          div
            style={{
              display flex,
              flexDirection column,
              alignItems center,
              gap 4,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                width 28,
                height 28,
                borderRadius 50%,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                justifyContent center,
                background
                  s.id  stage
                     #BD1313
                     s.id === stage
                       #BD1313
                       #E2E8F0,
                border
                  s.id === stage  2px solid #BD1313  none,
                color s.id = stage  white  #94A3B8,
                fontSize 11,
                fontWeight 700,
                boxShadow
                  s.id === stage
                     0 0 0 4px rgba(189,19,19,0.1)
                     none,
              }}
            
              {s.id  stage  Check size={14}   s.id + 1}
            div
            span
              style={{
                fontSize 9,
                fontWeight 500,
                color s.id = stage  #BD1313  #94A3B8,
                fontFamily F,
              }}
            
              {s.label}
            span
          div
          {i  stages.length - 1 && (
            div
              style={{
                flex 1,
                height 2,
                background
                  s.id  stage  #BD1313  #E2E8F0,
                marginLeft 4,
                marginRight 4,
                marginBottom 14,
              }}
            
          )}
        div
      ))}
    div
  );
}

 ─── Course Library ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function CourseLibrary({
  courses,
  allCourses,
  search,
  setSearch,
  catFilter,
  setCatFilter,
  levelFilter,
  setLevelFilter,
  statusFilter,
  setStatusFilter,
  viewMode,
  setViewMode,
  libraryTab,
  setLibraryTab,
  onCreateCourse,
  onEditCourse,
  onPreviewCourse,
  onDeleteCourse,
  onToggleStatus,
  onContinuePipeline,
  showToast,
} {
  courses Course[];
  allCourses Course[];
  search string;
  setSearch (v string) = void;
  catFilter string;
  setCatFilter (v string) = void;
  levelFilter string;
  setLevelFilter (v string) = void;
  statusFilter string;
  setStatusFilter (v string) = void;
  viewMode string;
  setViewMode (v string) = void;
  libraryTab published  in-progress;
  setLibraryTab (v published  in-progress) = void;
  onCreateCourse () = void;
  onEditCourse (c Course) = void;
  onPreviewCourse (c Course) = void;
  onDeleteCourse (id string) = void;
  onToggleStatus (c Course) = void;
  onContinuePipeline (c Course) = void;
  showToast (msg string, type string) = void;
}) {
  const publishedCourses = allCourses.filter(
    (c) = c.status === published,
  );
  const inProgressCourses = allCourses.filter(
    (c) = c.status !== published,
  );
  const stats = {
    total allCourses.length,
    published publishedCourses.length,
    draft allCourses.filter((c) = c.status === draft)
      .length,
    locked allCourses.filter((c) = c.status === locked)
      .length,
    learners allCourses.reduce((s, c) = s + c.learners, 0),
  };
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState
    string  null
  (null);

  return (
    div
      className=screen-enter
      style={{
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        height calc(100vh - 56px),
        overflow hidden,
        background #FDF8F4,
      }}
    
      { Stats Bar }
      div
        style={{
          height 80,
          background white,
          borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          padding 0 24px,
          display flex,
          alignItems center,
          gap 0,
          flexShrink 0,
        }}
      
        {[
          {
            dot #BD1313,
            val stats.total,
            label Total Courses,
          },
          {
            dot #16A34A,
            val stats.published,
            label Published,
          },
          { dot #D97706, val stats.draft, label Draft },
          {
            dot #64748B,
            val stats.locked,
            label In Progress,
          },
          {
            dot #2563EB,
            val stats.learners,
            label Total Learners,
          },
        ].map((s, i, arr) = (
          div
            key={i}
            style={{
              padding 0 24px,
              borderRight
                i  arr.length - 1
                   1px solid #EEE8E3
                   none,
              display flex,
              flexDirection column,
              gap 4,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 8,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  width 8,
                  height 8,
                  borderRadius 50%,
                  background s.dot,
                  flexShrink 0,
                }}
              
              span
                style={{
                  fontSize 22,
                  fontWeight 700,
                  color #1A1A2E,
                }}
              
                {s.val}
              span
            div
            span
              style={{
                fontSize 11,
                color #9898B0,
                fontWeight 500,
              }}
            
              {s.label}
            span
          div
        ))}
        div style={{ marginLeft auto }}
          button
            onClick={onCreateCourse}
            style={{
              height 44,
              padding 0 20px,
              background #BD1313,
              color white,
              border none,
              borderRadius 10,
              fontSize 14,
              fontWeight 600,
              cursor pointer,

              gap 8,
              fontFamily F,
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) = {
              (
                e.currentTarget as HTMLElement

            onMouseLeave={(e) = {
              (
                e.currentTarget as HTMLElement

          alignItems center,
          gap 0,
          flexShrink 0,
        }}
