                  justifyContent center,
                }}
              
                Trash2 size={20} color=#DC2626 
              div
              div
                div
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 16,
                    fontWeight 600,
                    color #1A1A2E,
                  }}
                
                  Delete Course
                div
                div
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 13,
                    color #9898B0,
                    marginTop 2,
                  }}
                
                  This action cannot be undone
                div
              div
            div
            div
              style={{
                padding 20,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                color #4A4A68,
                lineHeight 1.6,
              }}
            
              Are you sure you want to delete this course All
              associated sections, chapters, and content will be
              permanently removed.
            div
            div
              style={{
                padding 0 24px 24px,
                display flex,
                gap 12,
                justifyContent flex-end,
              }}
            
              button
                onClick={() = setConfirmDelete(null)}
                style={{
                  height 44,
                  padding 0 20px,
                  background transparent,
                  border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
                  borderRadius 10,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 14,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  color #4A4A68,
                  cursor pointer,
                }}
              
                Cancel
              button
              button
                onClick={() = {
                  onDeleteCourse(confirmDelete);
                  setConfirmDelete(null);
                }}
                style={{
                  height 44,
                  padding 0 20px,
                  background #DC2626,
                  color white,
                  border none,
                  borderRadius 10,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 14,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  cursor pointer,
                }}
              
                Delete Course
              button
            div
          div
        div
      )}
    div
  );
}

 ─── Course Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function CourseCard({
  course,
  onEdit,
  onPreview,
  onDelete,
  onToggle,
} {
  course Course;
  onEdit (c Course) = void;
  onPreview (c Course) = void;
  onDelete (id string) = void;
  onToggle (c Course) = void;
}) {
  const [hov, setHov] = useState(false);
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const totalChapters = course.sections.reduce(
    (s, sec) = s + sec.chapters.length,
    0,
  );
  return (
    div
      onMouseEnter={() = setHov(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() = {
        setHov(false);
        setMenuOpen(false);
      }}
      style={{
        background white,
        border `1px solid ${hov  #DDD7D0  #EEE8E3}`,
        borderRadius 16,
        padding 16,
        cursor pointer,
        transition all 0.2s,
        transform hov  translateY(-2px)  translateY(0),
        boxShadow hov
           0 8px 24px rgba(26,26,46,0.10)
           0 2px 8px rgba(26,26,46,0.06),
        position relative,
      }}
    
      { Top row }
      div
        style={{
          display flex,
          justifyContent space-between,
          alignItems flex-start,
          marginBottom 10,
        }}
      
        div style={{ display flex, gap 6 }}
          span
            style={{
              background #FDF2F2,
              color #BD1313,
              border 1px solid #F5BFBF,
              borderRadius 6,
              padding 2px 8px,
              fontSize 10,
              fontWeight 600,
              fontFamily F,
            }}
          
            {course.category.split( )[0]}
          span
          Badge status={course.status} 
        div
        div style={{ position relative }}
          button
            onClick={(e) = {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setMenuOpen(!menuOpen);
            }}
            style={{
              width 28,
              height 28,
              borderRadius 8,
              border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
              background white,
              cursor pointer,
              display flex,
              alignItems center,
              justifyContent center,
            }}
          
            MoreVertical size={14} color=#9898B0 
          button
          {menuOpen && (
            div
              style={{
                position absolute,
                right 0,
                top 32,
                background white,
                border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
                borderRadius 12,
                boxShadow 0 8px 24px rgba(26,26,46,0.12),
                zIndex 10,
                minWidth 160,
                overflow hidden,
              }}
            
              {[
                {
                  icon Eye size={14} ,
                  label Preview,
                  action () = {
                    onPreview(course);
                    setMenuOpen(false);
                  },
                },
                {
                  icon Edit3 size={14} ,
                  label Edit Course,
                  action () = {
                    onEdit(course);
                    setMenuOpen(false);
                  },
                },
                {
                  icon Copy size={14} ,
                  label Duplicate,
                  action () = setMenuOpen(false),
                },
                {
                  icon Trash2 size={14} ,
                  label Delete,
                  action () = {
                    onDelete(course.id);
                    setMenuOpen(false);
                  },
                  danger true,
                },
              ].map((item, i) = (
                button
                  key={i}
                  onClick={(e) = {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    item.action();
                  }}
                  style={{
                    width 100%,
                    padding 10px 14px,
                    border none,
                    background white,
                    cursor pointer,
                    display flex,
                    gap 8,
                    alignItems center,
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 13,
                    color (item as { danger boolean }).danger
                       #DC2626
                       #1A1A2E,
                    borderBottom
                      i  3  1px solid #F5F0EB  none,
                    transition background 0.15s,
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) =
                    ((
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.background = (
                      item as { danger boolean }
                    ).danger
                       #FEF2F2
                       #FDF8F4)
                  }
                  onMouseLeave={(e) =
                    ((
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.background = white)
                  }
                
                  {item.icon}
                  {item.label}
                button
              ))}
            div
          )}
        div
      div

      { Title }
      div
        style={{
          fontFamily F,
          fontSize 14,
          fontWeight 600,
          color #1A1A2E,
          lineHeight 1.4,
          marginBottom 6,
          display -webkit-box,
          WebkitLineClamp 2,
          WebkitBoxOrient vertical as const,
          overflow hidden,
        }}
      
        {course.title}
      div

      LevelChip level={course.level} 

      {course.tags && course.tags.length  0 && (
        div
          style={{
            display flex,
            gap 4,
            flexWrap wrap,
            marginTop 8,
          }}
        
          {course.tags.slice(0, 3).map((t) = (
            span
              key={t}
              style={{
                background #F5F0EB,
                color #6B6B8A,
                borderRadius 9999,
                padding 1px 8px,
                fontSize 10,
                fontWeight 500,
                fontFamily F,
              }}
            
              {t}
            span
          ))}
        div
      )}

      div
        style={{
          height 1,
          background #F5F0EB,
          margin 10px 0,
        }}
      

      div
        style={{ display flex, gap 12, marginBottom 12 }}
      
        {[
          { val course.sections.length, label sections },
          { val totalChapters, label chapters },
          { val course.learners, label learners },
        ].map((s, i) = (
          span
            key={i}
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 11,
              color #9898B0,
            }}
          
            span style={{ fontWeight 600, color #1A1A2E }}
              {s.val}
            span{ }
            {s.label}
          span
        ))}
      div

      div style={{ display flex, gap 8 }}
        button
          onClick={(e) = {
            e.stopPropagation();
            onPreview(course);
          }}
          style={{
            flex 1,
            height 36,
            background #FDF8F4,
            border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
            borderRadius 8,
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 12,
            fontWeight 600,
            color #4A4A68,
            cursor pointer,
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            justifyContent center,
            gap 6,
            transition all 0.2s,
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) = {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background =
              #EFF6FF;
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.borderColor =
              #BFDBFE;
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) = {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background =
              #FDF8F4;
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.borderColor =
              #EEE8E3;
          }}
        
          Eye size={13} 
          Preview
        button
        button
          onClick={(e) = {
            e.stopPropagation();
            onEdit(course);
          }}
          style={{
            flex 1,
            height 36,
            background #FDF2F2,
            border 1px solid #F5BFBF,
            borderRadius 8,
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 12,
            fontWeight 600,
            color #BD1313,
            cursor pointer,
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            justifyContent center,
            gap 6,
            transition all 0.2s,
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) = {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background =
              #BD1313;
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.color =
              white;
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) = {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background =
              #FDF2F2;
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.color =
              #BD1313;
          }}
        
          Edit3 size={13} 
          Edit
        button
      div
    div
  );
}

 ─── Create Course Wizard ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function CreateCourse({
  step,
  setStep,
  courseForm,
  setCourseForm,
  prereqInput,
  setPrereqInput,
  addPrereq,
  removePrereq,
  sections,
  addSection,
  updateSection,
  removeSection,
  toggleSection,
  expandedSections,
  selectedSectionId,
  setSelectedSectionId,
  addChapter,
  updateChapter,
  removeChapter,
  onSave,
  onBack,
  onPreview,
  isEditing,
  showToast,
} {
  step number;
  setStep (n number) = void;
  courseForm {
    title string;
    description string;
    category string;
    level string;
    prerequisites string[];
    tags string;
  };
  setCourseForm (
    fn (p CourseFormType) = CourseFormType,
  ) = void;
  prereqInput string;
  setPrereqInput (v string) = void;
  addPrereq () = void;
  removePrereq (i number) = void;
  sections Section[];
  addSection () = void;
  updateSection (
    id string,
    field string,
    val string,
  ) = void;
  removeSection (id string) = void;
  toggleSection (id string) = void;
  expandedSections Recordstring, boolean;
  selectedSectionId string  null;
  setSelectedSectionId (id string  null) = void;
  addChapter (secId string) = void;
  updateChapter (
    secId string,
    chId string,
    field string,
    val string,
  ) = void;
  removeChapter (secId string, chId string) = void;
  onSave (draft boolean) = void;
  onBack () = void;
  onPreview () = void;
  isEditing boolean;
  showToast (msg string, type string) = void;
}) {
  const steps = [
    Course Details,
    Sections,
    Chapters,
    Review & Save,
  ];

  const canGoNext = () = {
    if (step === 0)
      return !!(
        courseForm.title &&
        courseForm.category &&
        courseForm.level
      );
    if (step === 1)
      return (
        sections.length  0 &&
        sections.every((s) = s.title.trim())
      );
    if (step === 2)
      return sections.every(
        (s) =
          s.chapters.length  0 &&
          s.chapters.every((c) = c.title.trim()),
      );
    return true;
  };

  return (
    div
      className=screen-enter
      style={{
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        height calc(100vh - 56px),
        overflow hidden,
        background #FDF8F4,
      }}
    
      { Header }
      div
        style={{
          background white,
          borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          padding 16px 32px,
          flexShrink 0,
        }}
      
        div
          style={{
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            justifyContent space-between,
            marginBottom 16,
          }}
        
          button
            onClick={onBack}
            style={{
              display flex,
              alignItems center,
              gap 6,
              background transparent,
              border none,
              cursor pointer,
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 13,
              fontWeight 500,
              color #4A4A68,
            }}
          
            ArrowLeft size={16}  Back to Courses
          button
          span
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 12,
              color #9898B0,
            }}
          
            Step {step + 1} of 4
          span
        div
        StepIndicator steps={steps} current={step} 
      div

      { Step Content }
      div
        className=inner-scroll
        style={{
          flex 1,
          overflowY auto,
          padding 24px 32px,
        }}
      
        {step === 0 && (
          StepDetails
            courseForm={courseForm}
            setCourseForm={setCourseForm}
            prereqInput={prereqInput}
            setPrereqInput={setPrereqInput}
            addPrereq={addPrereq}
            removePrereq={removePrereq}
          
        )}
        {step === 1 && (
          StepSections
            sections={sections}
            addSection={addSection}
            updateSection={updateSection}
            removeSection={removeSection}
            toggleSection={toggleSection}
            expandedSections={expandedSections}
          
        )}
        {step === 2 && (
          StepChapters
            sections={sections}
            selectedSectionId={selectedSectionId}
            setSelectedSectionId={setSelectedSectionId}
            addChapter={addChapter}
            updateChapter={updateChapter}
            removeChapter={removeChapter}
          
        )}
        {step === 3 && (
          StepPreviewSummary
            courseForm={courseForm}
            sections={sections}
          
        )}
      div

      { Bottom CTA }
      div
        style={{
          height 64,
          background white,
          borderTop 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          padding 0 32px,
          display flex,
          alignItems center,
          justifyContent space-between,
          flexShrink 0,
          boxShadow 0 -2px 8px rgba(26,26,46,0.04),
        }}
      
        button
          onClick={() =
            step  0  setStep(step - 1)  onBack()
          }
          style={{
            height 44,
            padding 0 20px,
            background transparent,
            border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
            borderRadius 10,
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 14,
            fontWeight 600,
            color #4A4A68,
            cursor pointer,
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            gap 8,
          }}
        
          ArrowLeft size={16} 
          {step === 0  Cancel  Previous}
        button
        div style={{ display flex, gap 12 }}
          button
            onClick={() = onSave(true)}
            style={{
              height 44,
              padding 0 20px,
              background transparent,
              border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
              borderRadius 10,
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 14,
              fontWeight 600,
              color #4A4A68,
              cursor pointer,
              display flex,
              alignItems center,
              gap 8,
            }}
          
            Save size={16} 
            Save as Draft
          button
          {step === 2 && (
            button
              onClick={onPreview}
              style={{
                height 44,
                padding 0 20px,
                background transparent,
                border 1.5px solid #BD1313,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 600,
                color #BD1313,
                cursor pointer,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 8,
              }}
            
              Eye size={16} 
              Preview
            button
          )}
          {step  3  (
            button
              onClick={() = {
                if (canGoNext()) setStep(step + 1);
                else
                  showToast(
                    Please fill all required fields,
                    error,
                  );
              }}
              style={{
                height 44,
                padding 0 24px,
                background canGoNext()  #BD1313  #F5BFBF,
                color white,
                border none,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 600,
                cursor canGoNext()  pointer  not-allowed,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 8,
                transition all 0.2s,
              }}
            
              Next Step
              ArrowRight size={16} 
            button
          )  (
            button
              onClick={() = onSave(false)}
              style={{
                height 44,
                padding 0 24px,
                background #BD1313,
                color white,
                border none,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 600,
                cursor pointer,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 8,
              }}
            
              Upload size={16} 
              {isEditing  Save Changes  Publish Course}
            button
          )}
        div
      div
    div
  );
}

type CourseFormType = {
  title string;
  description string;
  category string;
  level string;
  prerequisites string[];
  tags string;
};

function StepDetails({
  courseForm,
  setCourseForm,
  prereqInput,
  setPrereqInput,
  addPrereq,
  removePrereq,
} {
  courseForm CourseFormType;
  setCourseForm (
    fn (p CourseFormType) = CourseFormType,
  ) = void;
  prereqInput string;
  setPrereqInput (v string) = void;
  addPrereq () = void;
  removePrereq (i number) = void;
}) {
  const upd = (field string, val string) =
    setCourseForm((prev) = ({ ...prev, [field] val }));
  return (
    div style={{ maxWidth 720, margin 0 auto }}
      div style={{ marginBottom 24 }}
        div
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 20,
            fontWeight 700,
            color #1A1A2E,
            marginBottom 4,
          }}
        
          Course Details
        div
        div
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 13,
            color #9898B0,
          }}
        
          Fill in the basic information about your course
        div
      div
      div
        style={{
          background white,
          border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          borderRadius 16,
          padding 24,
          display flex,
          flexDirection column,
          gap 20,
        }}
      
        CourseInput
          label=Course Title
          required
          placeholder=e.g. React Advanced Patterns
          value={courseForm.title}
          onChange={(e) = upd(title, e.target.value)}
        
        CourseInput
          label=Course Description
          placeholder=Describe what learners will gain from this course...
          value={courseForm.description}
          onChange={(e) = upd(description, e.target.value)}
          textarea
          rows={4}
        
        div
          style={{
            display grid,
            gridTemplateColumns 1fr 1fr,
            gap 16,
          }}
        
          CourseSelect
            label=Category
            required
            value={courseForm.category}
            onChange={(e) = upd(category, e.target.value)}
            options={CATEGORIES}
            placeholder=Select category...
          
          CourseSelect
            label=Skill Level
            required
            value={courseForm.level}
            onChange={(e) = upd(level, e.target.value)}
            options={LEVELS}
            placeholder=Select level...
          
        div
        CourseInput
          label=Tags (comma-separated)
          placeholder=e.g. React, JavaScript, Frontend
          value={courseForm.tags}
          onChange={(e) = upd(tags, e.target.value)}
          icon={Tag size={15} }
        
        div
          label
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 11,
              fontWeight 600,
              color #6B6B8A,
              textTransform uppercase as const,
              letterSpacing 0.8px,
              display block,
              marginBottom 8,
            }}
          
            Prerequisites{ }
            span
              style={{
                color #9898B0,
                fontSize 10,
                textTransform none as const,
                letterSpacing 0,
              }}
            
              (optional)
            span
          label
          div
            style={{ display flex, gap 8, marginBottom 8 }}
          
            input
              value={prereqInput}
              onChange={(e) = setPrereqInput(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) =
                e.key === Enter && addPrereq()
              }
              placeholder=Add a prerequisite and press Enter...
              style={{
                flex 1,
                height 44,
                padding 0 14px,
                border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                color #1A1A2E,
                background white,
                outline none,
              }}
              onFocus={(e) =
                (e.target.style.borderColor = #BD1313)
              }
              onBlur={(e) =
                (e.target.style.borderColor = #EEE8E3)
              }
            
            button
              onClick={addPrereq}
              style={{
                height 44,
                padding 0 16px,
                background #BD1313,
                color white,
                border none,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 600,
                cursor pointer,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 6,
              }}
            
              Plus size={16} 
              Add
            button
          div
          {courseForm.prerequisites.length  0 && (
            div
              style={{
                display flex,
                gap 8,
                flexWrap wrap,
              }}
            
              {courseForm.prerequisites.map((p, i) = (
                div
                  key={i}
                  style={{
                    display flex,
                    alignItems center,
                    gap 6,
                    background #FDF2F2,
                    border 1px solid #F5BFBF,
                    borderRadius 9999,
                    padding 4px 12px,
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 12,
                    color #BD1313,
                    fontWeight 500,
                  }}
                
                  {p}
                  button
                    onClick={() = removePrereq(i)}
                    style={{
                      background none,
                      border none,
                      cursor pointer,
                      color #BD1313,
                      display flex,
                      padding 0,
                    }}
                  
                    X size={13} 
                  button
                div
              ))}
            div
          )}
        div
      div
      div
        style={{
          background #FFF3EE,
          border 1px solid #FED7AA,
          borderRadius 12,
          padding 12px 16px,
          display flex,
          gap 10,
          alignItems flex-start,
          marginTop 16,
        }}
      
        Info
          size={16}
          color=#E8620A
          style={{ flexShrink 0, marginTop 1 }}
        
        span
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 12,
            color #E8620A,
            lineHeight 1.5,
          }}
        
          Course title and category are required. A good
          description helps learners understand what they will
          gain before enrolling.
        span
      div
    div
  );
}

function StepSections({
  sections,
  addSection,
  updateSection,
  removeSection,
  toggleSection,
  expandedSections,
} {
  sections Section[];
  addSection () = void;
  updateSection (
    id string,
    field string,
    val string,
  ) = void;
  removeSection (id string) = void;
  toggleSection (id string) = void;
  expandedSections Recordstring, boolean;
}) {
  return (
    div style={{ maxWidth 720, margin 0 auto }}
      div style={{ marginBottom 24 }}
        div
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 20,
            fontWeight 700,
            color #1A1A2E,
            marginBottom 4,
          }}
        
          Course Sections
        div
        div
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 13,
            color #9898B0,
          }}
        
          Organize your course into sections. Each section
          groups related chapters together.
        div
      div
      div
        style={{
          display flex,
          flexDirection column,
          gap 12,
        }}
      
        {sections.map((section, i) = (
          div
            key={section.id}
            style={{
              background white,
              border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
              borderRadius 16,
              overflow hidden,
              boxShadow 0 2px 8px rgba(26,26,46,0.04),
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 12,
                padding 14px 16px,
                borderBottom expandedSections[section.id]
                   1px solid #F5F0EB
                   none,
                background #FFFCFA,
                cursor pointer,
              }}
              onClick={() = toggleSection(section.id)}
            
              div
                style={{
                  width 28,
                  height 28,
                  borderRadius 8,
                  background #FDF2F2,
                  display flex,
                  alignItems center,
                  justifyContent center,
                  flexShrink 0,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 12,
                  fontWeight 700,
                  color #BD1313,
                }}
              
                {i + 1}
              div
              GripVertical
                size={16}
                color=#9898B0
                style={{ flexShrink 0 }}
              
              div
                style={{
                  flex 1,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 14,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  color section.title  #1A1A2E  #9898B0,
                }}
              
                {section.title  Section title...}
              div
              div
                style={{
                  display flex,
                  gap 6,
                  alignItems center,
                }}
              
                span
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 11,
                    color #9898B0,
                  }}
                
                  {section.chapters.length} chapters
                span
                {expandedSections[section.id]  (
                  ChevronUp size={16} color=#9898B0 
                )  (
                  ChevronDown size={16} color=#9898B0 
                )}
                button
                  onClick={(e) = {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    removeSection(section.id);
                  }}
                  style={{
                    width 28,
                    height 28,
                    borderRadius 8,
                    border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
                    background white,
                    cursor pointer,
                    display flex,
                    alignItems center,
                    justifyContent center,
                    marginLeft 4,
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) = {
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.background = #FEF2F2;
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.borderColor = #FECACA;
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) = {
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.background = white;
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.borderColor = #EEE8E3;
                  }}
                
                  Trash2 size={13} color=#DC2626 
                button
              div
            div
            {expandedSections[section.id] && (
              div
                style={{
                  padding 16,
                  display flex,
                  flexDirection column,
                  gap 12,
                }}
              
                CourseInput
                  label=Section Title
                  required
                  placeholder=e.g. Component Architecture
                  value={section.title}
                  onChange={(e) =
                    updateSection(
                      section.id,
                      title,
                      e.target.value,
                    )
                  }
                
                CourseInput
                  label=Section Description
                  placeholder=Brief description of this section...
                  value={section.desc}
                  onChange={(e) =
                    updateSection(
                      section.id,
                      desc,
                      e.target.value,
                    )
                  }
                  textarea
                  rows={2}
                
              div
            )}
          div
        ))}
        button
          onClick={addSection}
          style={{
            height 48,
            background white,
            border 2px dashed #EEE8E3,
            borderRadius 16,
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 14,
            fontWeight 600,
            color #BD1313,
            cursor pointer,
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            justifyContent center,
            gap 8,
            transition all 0.2s,
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) = {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background =
              #FDF2F2;
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.borderColor =
              #F5BFBF;
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) = {
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.background =
              white;
            (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).style.borderColor =
              #EEE8E3;
          }}
        
          Plus size={18}  Add Section
        button
      div
      {sections.length === 0 && (
        div
          style={{
            background #FFF3EE,
            border 1px solid #FED7AA,
            borderRadius 12,
            padding 16px,
            display flex,
            gap 10,
            alignItems flex-start,
            marginTop 16,
          }}
        
          Info
            size={16}
            color=#E8620A
            style={{ flexShrink 0 }}
          
          span
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 13,
              color #E8620A,
              lineHeight 1.5,
            }}
          
            At least one section is required. Click Add
            Section to get started.
          span
        div
      )}
    div
  );
}

function StepChapters({
  sections,
  selectedSectionId,
  setSelectedSectionId,
  addChapter,
  updateChapter,
  removeChapter,
} {
  sections Section[];
  selectedSectionId string  null;
  setSelectedSectionId (id string  null) = void;
  addChapter (secId string) = void;
  updateChapter (
    secId string,
    chId string,
    field string,
    val string,
  ) = void;
  removeChapter (secId string, chId string) = void;
}) {
  const activeSection =
    sections.find((s) = s.id === selectedSectionId) 
    sections[0];
  useEffect(() = {
    if (!selectedSectionId && sections.length  0)
      setSelectedSectionId(sections[0].id);
  }, [sections]);

  return (
    div style={{ maxWidth 960, margin 0 auto }}
      div style={{ marginBottom 24 }}
        div
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 20,
            fontWeight 700,
            color #1A1A2E,
            marginBottom 4,
          }}
        
          Add Chapters
        div
        div
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 13,
            color #9898B0,
          }}
        
          Select a section and add chapters to it. Each chapter
          is a learning unit.
        div
      div
      div
        style={{
          display grid,
          gridTemplateColumns 260px 1fr,
          gap 16,
          alignItems flex-start,
        }}
      
        { Section Selector }
        div
          style={{
            background white,
            border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
            borderRadius 16,
            overflow hidden,
            position sticky,
            top 0,
          }}
        
          div
            style={{
              padding 12px 16px,
              borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
              background #FDF8F4,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 12,
                fontWeight 600,
                color #6B6B8A,
                textTransform uppercase as const,
                letterSpacing 0.8px,
              }}
            
              Sections
            div
          div
          {sections.map((s, i) = (
            div
              key={s.id}
              onClick={() = setSelectedSectionId(s.id)}
              style={{
                padding 12px 16px,
                cursor pointer,
                borderBottom 1px solid #F5F0EB,
                background
                  s.id === activeSection.id
                     #FDF2F2
                     white,
                borderLeft
                  s.id === activeSection.id
                     3px solid #BD1313
                     3px solid transparent,
                transition all 0.15s,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  display flex,
                  justifyContent space-between,
                  alignItems center,
                }}
              
                div
                  div
                    style={{
                      fontFamily F,
                      fontSize 13,
                      fontWeight 600,
                      color
                        s.id === activeSection.id
                           #BD1313
                           #1A1A2E,
                    }}
                  
                    {s.title  `Section ${i + 1}`}
                  div
                  div
                    style={{
                      fontFamily F,
                      fontSize 11,
                      color #9898B0,
                      marginTop 2,
                    }}
                  
                    {s.chapters.length} chapters
                  div
                div
                {s.id === activeSection.id && (
                  ChevronRight size={14} color=#BD1313 
                )}
              div
            div
          ))}
        div

        { Chapter Editor }
        {activeSection && (
          div
            div
              style={{
                background white,
                border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
                borderRadius 16,
                overflow hidden,
                marginBottom 12,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  padding 12px 16px,
                  borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
                  background #FDF8F4,
                }}
              
                div
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 14,
                    fontWeight 600,
                    color #1A1A2E,
                  }}
                
                  {activeSection.title  Untitled Section}
                div
                div
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 11,
                    color #9898B0,
                    marginTop 1,
                  }}
                
                  {activeSection.chapters.length} chapters added
                div
              div
              div
                style={{
                  padding 16,
                  display flex,
                  flexDirection column,
                  gap 12,
                }}
              
                {activeSection.chapters.map((ch, ci) = (
                  div
                    key={ch.id}
                    style={{
                      background #FFFCFA,
                      border 1px solid #F5F0EB,
                      borderRadius 12,
                      padding 16,
                    }}
                  
                    div
                      style={{
                        display flex,
                        alignItems center,
                        gap 8,
                        marginBottom 12,
                      }}
                    
                      div
                        style={{
                          width 24,
                          height 24,
                          borderRadius 6,
                          background #EFF6FF,
                          display flex,
                          alignItems center,
                          justifyContent center,
                          fontFamily F,
                          fontSize 11,
                          fontWeight 700,
                          color #2563EB,
                          flexShrink 0,
                        }}
                      
                        {ci + 1}
                      div
                      div
                        style={{
                          flex 1,
                          fontFamily F,
                          fontSize 13,
                          fontWeight 600,
                          color #1A1A2E,
                        }}
                      
                        Chapter {ci + 1}
                      div
                      button
                        onClick={() =
                          removeChapter(activeSection.id, ch.id)
                        }
                        style={{
                          width 24,
                          height 24,
                          borderRadius 6,
                          border none,
                          background transparent,
                          cursor pointer,
                          display flex,
                          alignItems center,
                          justifyContent center,
                          color #9898B0,
                        }}
                        onMouseEnter={(e) =
                          ((
                            e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                          ).style.color = #DC2626)
                        }
                        onMouseLeave={(e) =
                          ((
                            e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                          ).style.color = #9898B0)
                        }
                      
                        X size={14} 
                      button
                    div
                    div
                      style={{
                        display flex,
                        flexDirection column,
                        gap 10,
                      }}
                    
                      CourseInput
                        label=Chapter Title
                        required
                        placeholder=e.g. Introduction to Hooks
                        value={ch.title}
                        onChange={(e) =
                          updateChapter(
                            activeSection.id,
                            ch.id,
                            title,
                            e.target.value,
                          )
                        }
                      
                      CourseInput
                        label=Chapter Description
                        placeholder=What will learners learn in this chapter
                        value={ch.desc}
                        onChange={(e) =
                          updateChapter(
                            activeSection.id,
                            ch.id,
                            desc,
                            e.target.value,
                          )
                        }
                        textarea
                        rows={2}
                      
                    div
                  div
                ))}
                button
                  onClick={() = addChapter(activeSection.id)}
                  style={{
                    height 44,
                    background white,
                    border 2px dashed #EEE8E3,
                    borderRadius 12,
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 13,
                    fontWeight 600,
                    color #BD1313,
                    cursor pointer,
                    display flex,
                    alignItems center,
                    justifyContent center,
                    gap 8,
                    transition all 0.2s,
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) = {
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.background = #FDF2F2;
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.borderColor = #F5BFBF;
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) = {
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.background = white;
                    (
                      e.currentTarget as HTMLElement
                    ).style.borderColor = #EEE8E3;
                  }}
                
                  Plus size={16} 
                  Add Chapter to 
                  {activeSection.title  this section}
                button
              div
            div
            {activeSection.chapters.length === 0 && (
              div
                style={{
                  background #FFF3EE,
                  border 1px solid #FED7AA,
                  borderRadius 12,
                  padding 12px 16px,
                  display flex,
                  gap 10,
                  alignItems center,
                }}
              
                Info
                  size={16}
                  color=#E8620A
                  style={{ flexShrink 0 }}
                
                span
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 13,
                    color #E8620A,
                  }}
                
                  At least one chapter is required per section.
                span
              div
            )}
          div
        )}
      div
    div
  );
}

function StepPreviewSummary({
  courseForm,
  sections,
} {
  courseForm CourseFormType;
  sections Section[];
}) {
  const totalChapters = sections.reduce(
    (s, sec) = s + sec.chapters.length,
    0,
  );
  return (
    div style={{ maxWidth 720, margin 0 auto }}
      div style={{ marginBottom 24 }}
        div
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 20,
            fontWeight 700,
            color #1A1A2E,
            marginBottom 4,
          }}
        
          Review & Publish
        div
        div
          style={{
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 13,
            color #9898B0,
          }}
        
          Review your course before publishing. You can go back
          to make changes.
        div
      div
      div
        style={{
          background white,
          border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          borderRadius 16,
          overflow hidden,
          marginBottom 16,
        }}
      
        div
          style={{
            background
              linear-gradient(135deg,#BD1313,#7A0D0D),
            padding 20px 24px,
            position relative,
            overflow hidden,
          }}
        
          div
            style={{
              position absolute,
              top -30,
              right -30,
              width 140,
              height 140,
              borderRadius 50%,
              background rgba(255,255,255,0.05),
            }}
          
          Badge status=draft 
          div
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 22,
              fontWeight 700,
              color white,
              marginTop 8,
              marginBottom 4,
            }}
          
            {courseForm.title  Untitled Course}
          div
          div
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 13,
              color rgba(255,255,255,0.75),
              lineHeight 1.6,
            }}
          
            {courseForm.description 
              No description provided}
          div
          div
            style={{ display flex, gap 12, marginTop 12 }}
          
            {[courseForm.category, courseForm.level]
              .filter(Boolean)
              .map((t) = (
                span
                  key={t}
                  style={{
                    background rgba(255,255,255,0.15),
                    border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2),
                    color white,
                    borderRadius 9999,
                    padding 3px 12px,
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 11,
                    fontWeight 500,
                  }}
                
                  {t}
                span
              ))}
          div
        div
        div
          style={{
            display grid,
            gridTemplateColumns repeat(3,1fr),
            gap 0,
            borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          }}
        
          {[
            { val sections.length, label Sections },
            { val totalChapters, label Chapters },
            { val 0, label Learners },
          ].map((s, i, arr) = (
            div
              key={i}
              style={{

                textAlign center as const,

                  i  arr.length - 1

              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  fontFamily F,

                  fontWeight 700,

                }}
              
                {s.val}
              div
              div
                style={{
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 11,
                  color #9898B0,
                  fontWeight 500,
                }}
              
                {s.label}
              div
            div
          ))}
        div
      div
      div
        style={{
          background white,
          border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          borderRadius 16,
          overflow hidden,
        }}
      
        div
          style={{
            padding 14px 20px,
            borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
            background #FDF8F4,
          }}
        
          div
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 14,
              fontWeight 600,
              color #1A1A2E,
            }}
          
            Course Structure
          div
        div
        {sections.map((s, i) = (
          div
            key={s.id}
            style={{
              borderBottom
                i  sections.length - 1
                   1px solid #F5F0EB
                   none,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                padding 12px 20px,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 10,
                background #FFFCFA,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  width 24,
                  height 24,
                  borderRadius 6,
                  background #FDF2F2,
                  display flex,
                  alignItems center,
                  justifyContent center,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 11,
                  fontWeight 700,
                  color #BD1313,
                }}
              
                {i + 1}
              div
              div
                div
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 13,
                    fontWeight 600,
                    color #1A1A2E,
                  }}
                
                  {s.title}
                div
                {s.desc && (
                  div
                    style={{
                      fontFamily F,
                      fontSize 11,
                      color #9898B0,
                      marginTop 1,
                    }}
                  
                    {s.desc}
                  div
                )}
              div
              span
                style={{
                  marginLeft auto,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 11,
                  color #9898B0,
                }}
              
                {s.chapters.length} chapters
              span
            div
            {s.chapters.map((c, ci) = (
              div
                key={c.id}
                style={{
                  padding 8px 20px 8px 54px,
                  display flex,
                  gap 8,
                  alignItems flex-start,
                  borderTop 1px solid #F5F0EB,
                }}
              
                div
                  style={{
                    width 20,
                    height 20,
                    borderRadius 4,
                    background #EFF6FF,
                    display flex,
                    alignItems center,
                    justifyContent center,
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 10,
                    fontWeight 600,
                    color #2563EB,
                    flexShrink 0,
                    marginTop 1,
                  }}
                
                  {ci + 1}
                div
                div
                  div
                    style={{
                      fontFamily F,
                      fontSize 13,
                      fontWeight 500,
                      color #1A1A2E,
                    }}
                  
                    {c.title}
                  div
                  {c.desc && (
                    div
                      style={{
                        fontFamily F,
                        fontSize 11,
                        color #9898B0,
                        marginTop 1,
                      }}
                    
                      {c.desc}
                    div
                  )}
                div
              div
            ))}
          div
        ))}
      div
      {courseForm.prerequisites.length  0 && (
        div
          style={{
            background white,
            border 1px solid #EEE8E3,
            borderRadius 16,
            padding 16,
            marginTop 16,
          }}
        
          div
            style={{
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 12,
              fontWeight 600,
              color #6B6B8A,
              textTransform uppercase as const,
              letterSpacing 0.8px,
              marginBottom 10,
            }}
          
            Prerequisites
          div
          div
            style={{
              display flex,
              gap 8,
              flexWrap wrap,
            }}
          
            {courseForm.prerequisites.map((p, i) = (
              span
                key={i}
                style={{
                  background #FDF2F2,
                  border 1px solid #F5BFBF,
                  color #BD1313,
                  borderRadius 9999,
                  padding 4px 12px,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 12,
                  fontWeight 500,
                }}
              
                {p}
              span
            ))}
          div
        div
      )}
    div
  );
}

 ─── Course Preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function CoursePreview({
  course,
  onBack,
  onSave,
  onSaveDraft,
  isFromLibrary,
} {
  course Course & { prerequisites string[] };
  onBack () = void;
  onSave () = void;
  onSaveDraft () = void;
  isFromLibrary boolean;
}) {
  const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState
    Recordstring, boolean
  ({});
  const totalChapters = course.sections.reduce(
    (s, sec) = s + sec.chapters.length,
    0,
  );
  const toggle = (id string) =
    setExpandedSections((prev) = ({
      ...prev,
      [id] !prev[id],
    }));

  return (
    div
      className=screen-enter
      style={{
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        height calc(100vh - 56px),
        overflow hidden,
        background #FDF8F4,
      }}
    
      { Preview Header }
      div
        style={{
          background white,
          borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
          padding 12px 24px,
          display flex,
          alignItems center,
          justifyContent space-between,
          flexShrink 0,
        }}
      
        button
          onClick={onBack}
          style={{
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            gap 6,
            background transparent,
            border none,
            cursor pointer,
            fontFamily F,
            fontSize 13,
            fontWeight 500,
            color #4A4A68,
          }}
        
          ArrowLeft size={16} 
          Back
        button
        div
          style={{
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            gap 8,
          }}
        
          span
            style={{
              background #FFF3EE,
              border 1px solid #FED7AA,
              color #E8620A,
              borderRadius 9999,
              padding 4px 12px,
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 12,
              fontWeight 600,
            }}
          
            👁 Preview Mode
          span
        div
        div style={{ display flex, gap 8 }}
          {!isFromLibrary && (
            button
              onClick={onSaveDraft}
              style={{
                height 40,
                padding 0 16px,
                background transparent,
                border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 13,
                fontWeight 600,
                color #4A4A68,
                cursor pointer,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 6,
              }}
            
              Save size={14} 
              Save Draft
            button
          )}
          {!isFromLibrary && (
            button
              onClick={onSave}
              style={{
                height 40,
                padding 0 16px,
                background #BD1313,
                color white,
                border none,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 13,
                fontWeight 600,
                cursor pointer,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                gap 6,
              }}
            
              Upload size={14} 
              Publish
            button
          )}
        div
      div

      div
        className=inner-scroll
        style={{ flex 1, overflowY auto }}
      
        { Hero }
        div
          style={{
            background
              linear-gradient(135deg,#BD1313 0%,#7A0D0D 100%),
            padding 40px 48px,
            position relative,
            overflow hidden,
          }}
        
          div
            style={{
              position absolute,
              top -60,
              right -60,
              width 300,
              height 300,
              borderRadius 50%,
              background rgba(255,255,255,0.04),
            }}
          
          div
            style={{
              position absolute,
              bottom -80,
              left -40,
              width 200,
              height 200,
              borderRadius 50%,
              background rgba(255,255,255,0.03),
            }}
          
          div style={{ position relative, maxWidth 800 }}
            div
              style={{
                display flex,
                gap 8,
                marginBottom 12,
              }}
            
              {[course.category, course.level, course.status]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .map((t) = (
                  span
                    key={t}
                    style={{
                      background rgba(255,255,255,0.15),
                      border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2),
                      color white,
                      borderRadius 9999,
                      padding 3px 12px,
                      fontFamily F,
                      fontSize 11,
                      fontWeight 500,
                    }}
                  
                    {t}
                  span
                ))}
            div
            h1
              style={{
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 28,
                fontWeight 700,
                color white,
                marginBottom 12,
                lineHeight 1.3,
              }}
            
              {course.title  Untitled Course}
            h1
            p
              style={{
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                color rgba(255,255,255,0.8),
                lineHeight 1.7,
                maxWidth 600,
              }}
            
              {course.description 
                No description provided for this course.}
            p
            div
              style={{
                display flex,
                gap 24,
                marginTop 20,
              }}
            
              {[
                { val `${course.sections.length} Sections` },
                { val `${totalChapters} Chapters` },
                { val `${course.learners  0} Learners` },
              ].map((s, i) = (
                div
                  key={i}
                  style={{
                    display flex,
                    alignItems center,
                    gap 8,

 ─── Upload Assets Screen ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function UploadAssetsScreen({
  course,
  onBack,
  onComplete,
  showToast,
} {
  course Course;
  onBack () = void;
  onComplete () = void;
  showToast (msg string, type string) = void;
}) {
  const [selectedChapter, setSelectedChapter] = useState(
    course.sections[0].chapters[0].id  ,
  );
  const [uploadedAssets, setUploadedAssets] = useState
    Recordstring, { primary string[]; additional string[] }
  ({});

  const allChaptersHaveAssets = course.sections.every((s) =
    s.chapters.every(
      (ch) = uploadedAssets[ch.id].primary.length  0,
    ),
  );

  return (
    div
      style={{
        display flex,
        height calc(100vh - 56px),
        background #FDF8F4,
      }}
    
      { Left Sidebar }

        }}

            padding 16,
            borderBottom 1px solid #E2E8F0,

              fontSize 13,
              fontWeight 600,
              color #94A3B8,
              fontFamily F,
              textTransform uppercase,
              letterSpacing 0.6px,
            }}
          
            Course Structure
          div
        div
        {course.sections.map((section) = (
          div
            key={section.id}
            style={{ borderBottom 1px solid #F8FAFC }}
          
            div
              style={{
                padding 12px 16px,
                fontWeight 600,
                fontSize 13,
                color #1A1A2E,
                fontFamily F,
              }}
            
              {section.title}
            div
            {section.chapters.map((ch) = (
              div
                key={ch.id}
                onClick={() = setSelectedChapter(ch.id)}
                style={{
                  padding 8px 16px 8px 32px,
                  cursor pointer,
                  background
                    selectedChapter === ch.id
                       #FDF2F2
                       transparent,
                  borderLeft
                    selectedChapter === ch.id
                       3px solid #BD1313
                       3px solid transparent,
                  display flex,
                  alignItems center,
                  gap 8,
                }}
              
                div
                  style={{
                    width 8,
                    height 8,
                    borderRadius 50%,
                    background
                      uploadedAssets[ch.id].primary.length  0
                         #16A34A
                         uploadedAssets[ch.id].additional
                              .length  0
                           #2563EB
                           #E2E8F0,
                  }}
                
                span
                  style={{
                    fontSize 13,
                    color
                      selectedChapter === ch.id
                         #BD1313
                         #475569,
                    fontFamily F,
                  }}
                
                  {ch.title}
                span
              div
            ))}
          div
        ))}
      div

      { Right Upload Area }
      div style={{ flex 1, padding 24, overflowY auto }}
        button
          onClick={onBack}
          style={{
            marginBottom 20,
            height 36,
            padding 0 16px,
            background transparent,
            border 1px solid #E2E8F0,
            borderRadius 8,
            fontSize 13,
            fontWeight 600,
            color #64748B,
            cursor pointer,
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            gap 6,
            fontFamily F,
          }}
        
          ArrowLeft size={14} 
          Back
        button

        div
          style={{
            fontSize 20,
            fontWeight 700,
            color #1A1A2E,
            fontFamily F,
            marginBottom 4,
          }}
        
          Upload Assets — {course.title}
        div
        div
          style={{
            fontSize 13,
            color #64748B,
            fontFamily F,
            marginBottom 24,
          }}
        
          Upload learning materials for each chapter
        div

        div
          style={{
            display grid,
            gridTemplateColumns 1fr 1fr,
            gap 16,
            marginBottom 24,
          }}

 ─── Train Model Screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function TrainModelScreen({
  course,
  onBack,
  onComplete,
  showToast,
} {
  course Course;
  onBack () = void;
  onComplete () = void;
  showToast (msg string, type string) = void;
}) {
  const [state, setState] = useState
    idle  training  complete
  (idle);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);

  const startTraining = () = {
    setState(training);
    setProgress(0);
    const interval = setInterval(() = {
      setProgress((p) = {
        if (p = 100) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          setState(complete);
          return 100;
        }
        return p + 2;
      });
    }, 60);
  };

  const steps = [
    {
      id 1,
      label Analyzing uploaded content,
      state
        progress  0
           complete
           progress === 0 && state === training
             active
             pending,
    },
    {
      id 2,
      label Processing video transcripts,
      state
        progress  25
           complete
           progress  0 && progress = 25
             active
             pending,
    },
    {
      id 3,
      label Building knowledge graph,
      state
        progress  50
           complete
           progress  25 && progress = 50
             active
             pending,
    },
    {
      id 4,
      label Calibrating difficulty model,
      state
        progress  75
           complete
           progress  50
             active
             pending,
    },
  ];

  return (
    div
      style={{
        display flex,
        flexDirection column,
        alignItems center,
        justifyContent center,
        height calc(100vh - 56px),
        background #FDF8F4,
        padding 40,
      }}
    
      div
        style={{
          background white,
          border 1px solid #E2E8F0,
          borderRadius 20,
          padding 40,
          textAlign center,
          maxWidth 600,
          width 100%,
        }}
      
        Zap
          size={48}
          color=#BD1313
          style={{ margin 0 auto 16px }}
        
        div
          style={{
            fontSize 20,
            fontWeight 700,
            color #0F172A,
            fontFamily F,
            marginTop 16,
          }}
        
          Train AI Model
        div
        div
          style={{
            fontSize 14,
            color #64748B,
            fontFamily F,
            marginTop 8,
            lineHeight 1.6,
          }}
        
          The AI will analyze your course content and prepare
          intelligent test generation
        div

        div
          style={{
            display grid,
            gridTemplateColumns 1fr 1fr,
            gap 12,
            marginTop 24,
            marginBottom 24,
          }}
        
          {[
            { label Total Assets, value 24 files },
            {
              label Est. Training Time,
              value ~12 minutes,
            },
            {
              label Sections,
              value course.sections.length,
            },
            {
              label Chapters,
              value course.sections.reduce(
                (s, sec) = s + sec.chapters.length,
                0,
              ),
            },
          ].map((item) = (
            div
              key={item.label}
              style={{
                background #F8FAFC,
                borderRadius 10,
                padding 14,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  fontSize 11,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  color #94A3B8,
                  fontFamily F,
                  textTransform uppercase,
                  letterSpacing 0.6px,
                }}
              
                {item.label}
              div
              div
                style={{
                  fontSize 15,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  color #0F172A,
                  fontFamily F,
                  marginTop 4,
                }}
              
                {item.value}
              div
            div
          ))}
        div

        {state === idle && (
          button
            onClick={startTraining}
            style={{
              width 100%,
              height 48,
              background #BD1313,
              color white,
              border none,
              borderRadius 10,
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 14,
              fontWeight 700,
              cursor pointer,
            }}
          
            Start Training
          button
        )}

        {state === training && (
          
            div
              style={{
                width 100%,
                height 8,
                background #F1F5F9,
                borderRadius 9999,
                overflow hidden,
                marginBottom 12,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  height 100%,
                  width `${progress}%`,
                  background #BD1313,
                  transition width 0.3s,
                }}
              
            div
            div
              style={{
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 500,
                color #475569,
                fontFamily F,
              }}
            
              Training in progress...
            div
            div
              style={{
                fontSize 13,
                color #94A3B8,
                fontFamily F,
                marginTop 4,
              }}
            
              ~{Math.max(1, Math.ceil((100 - progress)  10))}{ }
              minutes remaining
            div

            div
              style={{
                marginTop 20,
                display flex,
                flexDirection column,
                gap 8,
                textAlign left,
              }}
            
              {steps.map((step) = (
                div
                  key={step.id}
                  style={{
                    display flex,
                    alignItems center,
                    gap 10,
                  }}
                
                  {step.state === complete  (
                    CheckCircle size={16} color=#16A34A 
                  )  step.state === active  (
                    div
                      style={{
                        width 16,
                        height 16,
                        border 2px solid #E2E8F0,
                        borderTop 2px solid #BD1313,
                        borderRadius 50%,
                        animation spin 1s linear infinite,
                      }}
                    
                  )  (
                    div
                      style={{
                        width 16,
                        height 16,
                        borderRadius 50%,
                        border 2px solid #E2E8F0,
                      }}
                    
                  )}
                  span
                    style={{
                      fontSize 13,
                      color
                        step.state === complete
                           #16A34A
                           step.state === active
                             #0F172A
                             #94A3B8,
                      fontFamily F,
                    }}
                  
                    {step.label}
                  span
                div
              ))}
            div
          
        )}

        {state === complete && (
          
            div
              style={{
                width 80,
                height 80,
                borderRadius 50%,
                background #DCFCE7,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                justifyContent center,
                margin 0 auto 16px,
              }}
            
              CheckCircle size={40} color=#16A34A 
            div
            div
              style={{
                fontSize 18,
                fontWeight 700,
                color #16A34A,
                fontFamily F,
              }}
            
              Model Trained Successfully!
            div
            div
              style={{
                fontSize 13,
                color #64748B,
                fontFamily F,
                marginTop 6,
              }}
            
              Your course AI is ready to generate intelligent
              tests
            div
            button
              onClick={onComplete}
              style={{
                marginTop 24,
                width 100%,
                height 48,
                background #BD1313,
                color white,
                border none,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 700,
                cursor pointer,
              }}
            
              Generate Test →
            button
          
        )}
      div
    div
  );
}

 ─── Generate Test Config Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function GenerateTestScreen({
  course,
  onBack,
  onGenerate,
  showToast,
} {
  course Course;
  onBack () = void;
  onGenerate () = void;
  showToast (msg string, type string) = void;
}) {
  const [testName, setTestName] = useState();
  const [questionTypes, setQuestionTypes] = useState({
    mcq 10,
    trueFalse 5,
    shortAnswer 0,
    longAnswer 0,
  });
  const [scope, setScope] = useStatewhole  specific(
    whole,
  );

    string[]
  (course.sections.map((s) = s.id));

    easy  medium  hard  mixed
  (mixed);

  const total = Object.values(questionTypes).reduce(
    (s, v) = s + v,
    0,
  );

  return (
    div
      style={{

      }}

            display flex,

            gap 6,
            fontFamily F,
          }}
        
          ArrowLeft size={14} 
          Back

                  button

                      setQuestionTypes((p) = ({
                        ...p,
                        [qt.key] parseInt(e.target.value)  0,
                      }))
                    }
                    style={{
                      width 40,

            div

                display flex,
