 ─── Lock Confirmation Modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function LockModal({
  course,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
} {
  course Course  null;
  onClose () = void;
  onConfirm () = void;
}) {
  if (!course) return null;
  return (
    div
      style={{
        position fixed,
        inset 0,
        background rgba(26,26,46,0.5),
        backdropFilter blur(4px),
        zIndex 400,
        display flex,
        alignItems center,
        justifyContent center,
      }}
      onClick={onClose}
    
      div
        onClick={(e) = e.stopPropagation()}
        style={{
          background white,
          borderRadius 20,
          width 400,
          boxShadow 0 20px 60px rgba(26,26,46,0.18),
        }}
      
        div style={{ padding 24 }}
          div
            style={{
              fontSize 18,
              fontWeight 700,
              fontFamily F,
              color #1A1A2E,
              marginBottom 8,
            }}
          
            Lock This Course
          div
          div
            style={{
              fontSize 14,
              fontFamily F,
              color #64748B,
              lineHeight 1.6,
              marginBottom 16,
            }}
          
            Once locked, this course cannot be edited. You will
            proceed to upload learning assets.
          div
          div
            style={{
              background #FEF3C7,
              border 1px solid #FCD34D,
              borderRadius 8,
              padding 12,
              display flex,
              gap 10,
              marginBottom 20,
            }}
          
            AlertTriangle
              size={18}
              color=#D97706
              style={{ flexShrink 0, marginTop 2 }}
            
            div
              style={{
                fontSize 12,
                fontFamily F,
                color #D97706,
              }}
            
              This action cannot be undone. Review all course
              details before locking.
            div
          div
          div style={{ display flex, gap 12 }}
            button
              onClick={onClose}
              style={{
                flex 1,
                height 44,
                background transparent,
                border 1.5px solid #E2E8F0,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 600,
                color #64748B,
                cursor pointer,
              }}
            
              Cancel
            button
            button
              onClick={onConfirm}
              style={{
                flex 2,
                height 44,
                background #BD1313,
                color white,
                border none,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 600,
                cursor pointer,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                justifyContent center,
                gap 6,
              }}
            
              Lock size={16} 
              Lock & Continue
            button
          div
        div
      div
    div
  );
}

 ─── Publish Confirmation Modal ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function PublishModal({
  course,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
} {
  course Course  null;
  onClose () = void;
  onConfirm () = void;
}) {
  if (!course) return null;
  return (
    div
      style={{
        position fixed,
        inset 0,
        background rgba(26,26,46,0.5),
        backdropFilter blur(4px),
        zIndex 400,
        display flex,
        alignItems center,
        justifyContent center,
      }}
      onClick={onClose}
    
      div
        onClick={(e) = e.stopPropagation()}
        style={{
          background white,
          borderRadius 20,
          width 420,
          boxShadow 0 20px 60px rgba(26,26,46,0.18),
        }}
      
        div style={{ padding 24 }}
          div
            style={{
              fontSize 18,
              fontWeight 700,
              fontFamily F,
              color #1A1A2E,
              marginBottom 8,
            }}
          
            Publish Course
          div
          div
            style={{
              fontSize 14,
              fontFamily F,
              color #64748B,
              lineHeight 1.6,
              marginBottom 16,
            }}
          
            Your course will go live for enrolled students. The
            AI test will be available for batch assignment.
          div
          div
            style={{
              background #F8FAFC,
              borderRadius 10,
              padding 12,
              marginBottom 20,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                fontSize 13,
                fontFamily F,
                color #0F172A,
              }}
            
              strong{course.title}strong
            div
            div
              style={{
                fontSize 12,
                fontFamily F,
                color #64748B,
                marginTop 4,
              }}
            
              Sections {course.sections.length}  Chapters{ }
              {course.sections.reduce(
                (s, sec) = s + sec.chapters.length,
                0,
              )}{ }
               Questions 20
            div
          div
          div style={{ display flex, gap 12 }}
            button
              onClick={onClose}
              style={{
                flex 1,
                height 44,
                background transparent,
                border 1.5px solid #E2E8F0,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 600,
                color #64748B,
                cursor pointer,
              }}
            
              Cancel
            button
            button
              onClick={onConfirm}
              style={{
                flex 2,
                height 44,
                background #BD1313,
                color white,
                border none,
                borderRadius 10,
                fontFamily F,
                fontSize 14,
                fontWeight 600,
                cursor pointer,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                justifyContent center,
                gap 6,
              }}
            
              Zap size={16} 
              Publish Now
            button
          div
        div
      div
    div
  );
}

    { id number; message string; type string }[]
  ([]);

    null,
  );
  const [searchFocused, setSearchFocused] = useState(false);

   ── Course Module State ──
  const [courseSubView, setCourseSubView] = useState
     library
     create
     preview
     upload-assets
     train-model
     generate-test
     preview-questions
  (library);
  const [courseLibraryTab, setCourseLibraryTab] = useState
    published  in-progress
  (published);
  const [createStep, setCreateStep] = useState(0);
  const [courseList, setCourseList] =
    useStateCourse[](initialCourses);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState(grid);
  const [courseSearch, setCourseSearch] = useState();
  const [catFilter, setCatFilter] = useState(All);
  const [levelFilter, setLevelFilter] = useState(All);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState(All);
  const [previewCourse, setPreviewCourse] = useState
    (Course & { prerequisites string[] })  null
  (null);
  const [editingCourse, setEditingCourse] =
    useStateCourse  null(null);
  const [courseForm, setCourseForm] = useStateCourseFormType({
    title ,
    description ,
    category ,
    level ,
    prerequisites [],
    tags ,
  });
  const [prereqInput, setPrereqInput] = useState();
  const [sections, setSections] = useStateSection[]([]);
  const [selectedSectionId, setSelectedSectionId] = useState
    string  null
  (null);
  const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState
    Recordstring, boolean
  ({});
  const [showLockModal, setShowLockModal] = useState(false);
  const [showPublishModal, setShowPublishModal] =
    useState(false);
  const [selectedPipelineCourse, setSelectedPipelineCourse] =
    useStateCourse  null(null);

   ── Batch Module State ──
  const [batchSubView, setBatchSubView] = useState
     list
     create
     detail
     class-test
     test-correction
  (list);
  const [createBatchStep, setCreateBatchStep] = useState(0);
  const [batchList, setBatchList] =
    useStateBatch[](initialBatches);
  const [selectedBatch, setSelectedBatch] =
    useStateBatch  null(null);

  const showToast = (message string, type = default) = {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setToasts((prev) = [...prev, { id, message, type }]);
    setTimeout(() = {
      setToasts((prev) = prev.filter((t) = t.id !== id));
    }, 3000);
  };

   Feedback helper functions
  const filteredFb = fbList.filter((f) = {
    const ms =
      fbSearch ===  
      f.student
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(fbSearch.toLowerCase()) 
      f.message
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(fbSearch.toLowerCase()) 
      f.course.toLowerCase().includes(fbSearch.toLowerCase());
    const mt =
      fbTypeFilter === All  f.type === fbTypeFilter;
    const mst =
      fbStatusFilter === All  f.status === fbStatusFilter;
    const mse =
      fbSentimentFilter === All 
      f.sentiment === fbSentimentFilter;
    const mr =
      fbRatingFilter === All 
      String(f.rating) === fbRatingFilter;
    return ms && mt && mst && mse && mr;
  });
  const fbAvgRating = (
    fbList.reduce((s, f) = s + f.rating, 0)  fbList.length
  ).toFixed(1);
  const fbPositive = fbList.filter(
    (f) = f.sentiment === positive,
  ).length;
  const fbNegative = fbList.filter(
    (f) = f.sentiment === negative,
  ).length;
  const fbFlagged = fbList.filter(
    (f) = f.status === flagged,
  ).length;
  const markFbStatus = (id string, status string) = {
    setFbList((prev) =
      prev.map((f) = (f.id === id  { ...f, status }  f)),
    );
    if (selectedFb.id === id)
      setSelectedFb((prev) =
        prev  { ...prev, status }  prev,
      );
    showToast(`Feedback marked as ${status}`, success);
  };
  const deleteFb = (id string) = {
    setFbList((prev) = prev.filter((f) = f.id !== id));
    setFbSubView(list);
    setSelectedFb(null);
    showToast(Feedback deleted, default);
  };
  const sendFbReply = () = {

  const startCreateCourse = (course Course  null = null) = {
    if (course) {
      setCourseForm({
        title course.title,
        description course.description  ,
        category course.category,
        level course.level,
        prerequisites course.prerequisites  [],
        tags (course.tags  []).join(, ),
      });
      setSections(
        JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(course.sections  [])),
      );
      setEditingCourse(course);
    } else {
      setCourseForm({
        title ,
        description ,
        category ,
        level ,
        prerequisites [],
        tags ,
      });
      setSections([]);
      setEditingCourse(null);
    }
    setCreateStep(0);

    setExpandedSections({});

  };

  const addSection = () = {
    const newSection Section = {
      id uid(),
      title ,
      desc ,
      chapters [],
    };
    setSections((prev) = [...prev, newSection]);
    setExpandedSections((prev) = ({
      ...prev,
      [newSection.id] true,
    }));
  };
  const updateSection = (
    id string,
    field string,
    val string,
  ) =
    setSections((prev) =
      prev.map((s) =
        s.id === id  { ...s, [field] val }  s,
      ),
    );
  const removeSection = (id string) = {
    setSections((prev) = prev.filter((s) = s.id !== id));
    if (selectedSectionId === id) setSelectedSectionId(null);
  };
  const toggleSection = (id string) =
    setExpandedSections((prev) = ({
      ...prev,
      [id] !prev[id],
    }));

  const addChapter = (sectionId string) = {
    setSections((prev) =
      prev.map((s) =
        s.id === sectionId
           {
              ...s,
              chapters [
                ...s.chapters,
                { id uid(), title , desc , content [] },
              ],
            }
           s,
      ),
    );
  };
  const updateChapter = (
    sectionId string,
    chapterId string,
    field string,
    val string,
  ) = {
    setSections((prev) =
      prev.map((s) =
        s.id === sectionId
           {
              ...s,
              chapters s.chapters.map((c) =
                c.id === chapterId  { ...c, [field] val }  c,
              ),
            }
           s,
      ),
    );
  };
  const removeChapter = (
    sectionId string,
    chapterId string,
  ) = {
    setSections((prev) =
      prev.map((s) =
        s.id === sectionId
           {
              ...s,
              chapters s.chapters.filter(
                (c) = c.id !== chapterId,
              ),
            }
           s,
      ),
    );
  };

  const saveCourse = (asDraft = false) = {
    if (
      !courseForm.title 
      !courseForm.category 
      !courseForm.level
    ) {
      showToast(Please fill required fields, error);
      return;
    }
    const courseData Course = {
      id editingCourse
         editingCourse.id
         CRS- +
          String(courseList.length + 1).padStart(3, 0),
      title courseForm.title,
      description courseForm.description,
      category courseForm.category,
      level courseForm.level,
      status asDraft  draft  uploaded,
      sections,
      learners editingCourse  editingCourse.learners  0,
      created editingCourse
         editingCourse.created
         new Date().toLocaleDateString(en-US, {
            month short,
            day numeric,
            year numeric,
          }),
      tags courseForm.tags
        .split(,)
        .map((t) = t.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
      prerequisites courseForm.prerequisites,
    };
    if (editingCourse)
      setCourseList((prev) =
        prev.map((c) =
          c.id === editingCourse.id  courseData  c,
        ),
      );
    else setCourseList((prev) = [...prev, courseData]);
    showToast(
      editingCourse
         Course updated successfully
         Course created successfully,
      success,
    );
    setCourseSubView(library);
  };

  const addPrereq = () = {
    if (prereqInput.trim()) {
      setCourseForm((prev) = ({
        ...prev,
        prerequisites [
          ...prev.prerequisites,
          prereqInput.trim(),
        ],
      }));
      setPrereqInput();
    }
  };
  const removePrereq = (i number) =
    setCourseForm((prev) = ({
      ...prev,
      prerequisites prev.prerequisites.filter(
        (_, idx) = idx !== i,
      ),
    }));

  const updateOption = (
    id string,
    optIdx number,
    val string,
  ) = {
    setQuestions((prev) =
      prev.map((q) = {
        if (q.id !== id) return q;
        const opts = [...q.options];
        opts[optIdx] = val;
        return { ...q, options opts };
      }),
    );
  };

   Expose showToast for demo use (suppresses unused warning)
  void showToast;

  useEffect(() = {

      setTipVisible(false);
      setTimeout(() = {

  }, []);

   ── Reports Navigation ──
  const goToBatchReport = (batch BatchReport) = {
    setSelectedBatchReport(batch);
    setReportView(batch-detail);
  };
  const goToStudentReport = (student StudentReport) = {
    setSelectedStudentReport(student);

  };
  const goToTestReport = (test TestReport) = {
    setSelectedTestReport(test);
    setReportView(test-detail);
  };
  const goBackToReports = () = {
    setReportView(overview);
    setSelectedBatchReport(null);
    setSelectedStudentReport(null);
    setSelectedTestReport(null);
  };

  const breadcrumbMap Recordstring, string = {
    dashboard Dashboard,
    supervisors Supervisor Management,
    batches Batches,
    batch-create Batches  Create Batch,
    class-test Batches  Class Test,
    reports Reports,
    reports-batch Reports  Batch Report,
    reports-student Reports  Student Report,
    reports-test Reports  Test Report,
    feedback Feedback,
    settings Settings,
  };

  const getBreadcrumb = () = {
    if (screen === courses) {
      if (courseSubView === library) return Courses;
      if (courseSubView === create)
        return `Courses  ${editingCourse  Edit Course  Create Course}`;
      if (courseSubView === preview)
        return Courses  Preview;
    }
    if (screen === batches) {
      if (batchSubView === list) return Batches;
      if (batchSubView === create)
        return `Batches  ${editingBatch  Edit Batch  Create Batch}`;
      if (batchSubView === detail)
        return `Batches  ${selectedBatch.name  Batch Detail}`;
      if (batchSubView === class-test)
        return Batches  Class Test;
      if (batchSubView === test-correction)
        return `Batches  ${selectedTestForCorrection.name  Test Correction}`;
    }
    if (screen === reports) {
      if (reportView === overview) return Reports;
      if (reportView === batch-detail)
        return `Reports  ${selectedBatchReport.name  Batch Report}`;
      if (reportView === student-detail)
        return `Reports  ${selectedStudentReport.name  Student Report}`;
      if (reportView === test-detail)
        return `Reports  ${selectedTestReport.name  Test Report}`;
    }
    if (screen === feedback) {
      if (fbSubView === detail)
        return `Feedback  ${selectedFb.student  Detail}`;
      if (fbSubView === templates)
        return Feedback  Templates;
      if (fbSubView === create-template)
        return `Feedback  ${selectedTemplate  Edit Template  Create Template}`;
      return Feedback;
    }
    return breadcrumbMap[screen]  Dashboard;
  };

  const breadcrumb = getBreadcrumb();
  const breadcrumbParts = breadcrumb.split(  );

  const navItems = [
    {
      id dashboard,
      label Dashboard,
      icon httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48dashboard.png,
      active screen === dashboard,
    },
    {
      id supervisors,
      label Supervisors,
      icon httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48manager.png,
      active screen === supervisors,
    },
    {
      id courses,
      label Courses,
      icon httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48online-learning.png,
      active screen.startsWith(course),
    },
    {
      id batches,
      label Batches,
      icon httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48group.png,
      active
        screen.startsWith(batch)  screen === class-test,
    },
    {
      id reports,
      label Reports,
      icon httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48bar-chart.png,
      active screen.startsWith(report),
    },
    {
      id feedback,
      label Feedback,
      icon httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48feedback.png,
      active screen === feedback,
    },
  ];

  const renderScreen = () = {
    switch (screen) {
      case dashboard
        return (
          DashboardScreen
            setScreen={setScreen}
            tipIndex={tipIndex}
            tipVisible={tipVisible}
            onCreateCourse={() = {
              setEditingCourse(null);
              setCourseSubView(create);
              setScreen(courses);
            }}
            onCreateBatch={() = {
              setEditingBatch(null);
              setBatchSubView(create);
              setScreen(batches);
            }}

              startClassTest();
              setScreen(batches);
            }}
            onViewBatch={(batchId) = {
              const batch = batchList.find(
                (b) = b.id === batchId,
              );
              if (batch) {
                setSelectedBatch(batch);
                setBatchSubView(detail);
                setScreen(batches);
              }
            }}
            onViewCourse={(courseId) = {
              const course = courseList.find(
                (c) = c.id === courseId,
              );
              if (course) {
                setPreviewCourse(course);
                setCourseSubView(preview);
                setScreen(courses);
              }
            }}

      case supervisors
        return SupervisorScreen showToast={showToast} ;
      case courses
        if (courseSubView === library)

              setCatFilter={setCatFilter}

                setPreviewCourse(c);
                setCourseSubView(preview);
              }}

                setCourseList((prev) =
                  prev.filter((c) = c.id !== id),
                );

                const newStatus =
                  course.status === published
                     draft
                     course.status === draft
                       locked
                       published;

                  prev.map((c) =
                    c.id === course.id
                       { ...c, status newStatus }
                       c,
                  ),

                  `Course status updated to ${newStatus}`,
                  success,
                );
              }}

                setSelectedPipelineCourse(course);
                if (course.status === draft)
                  setShowLockModal(true);
                else if (course.status === locked)
                  setCourseSubView(upload-assets);
                else if (course.status === assets-uploaded)
                  setCourseSubView(train-model);
                else if (course.status === model-trained)
                  setCourseSubView(generate-test);
                else if (course.status === test-generated)
                  setCourseSubView(preview-questions);

        if (courseSubView === create)

              removeSection={removeSection}

              setSelectedSectionId={setSelectedSectionId}

              isEditing={!!editingCourse}
              showToast={showToast}
            
          );
        if (courseSubView === preview && previewCourse)

              course={previewCourse}

                setCourseSubView(

                     create
                     library,

              onSave={() = saveCourse(false)}
              onSaveDraft={() = saveCourse(true)}

                !courseForm.title && !!editingCourse
              }
            
          );
        if (
          courseSubView === upload-assets &&
          selectedPipelineCourse
        )
          return (

                setCourseLibraryTab(in-progress);
              }}

                setCourseList((prev) =

                          ...c,
                          status assets-uploaded as const,
                          pipelineStage 2,
                        }
                       c,
                  ),

                setCourseSubView(train-model);
                showToast(
                  Assets uploaded successfully,
                  success,
                );

              showToast={showToast}

          courseSubView === train-model &&

                          ...c,

                          ...c,

              setStudentSearch={setStudentSearch}

                  created formatDate(new Date()),
                  usageCount 0,
                  status draft,
                };
                setTemplateList([...templateList, newTemplate]);
              }}
              onDelete={(id) = {
                setTemplateList(
                  templateList.filter((t) = t.id !== id),
                );
              }}
              showToast={showToast}
            
          );
        if (fbSubView === create-template)
          return (
            CreateFeedbackTemplate
              template={selectedTemplate  undefined}
              onSave={(template) = {

                  setTemplateList(

                      t.id === selectedTemplate.id
                         { ...selectedTemplate, ...template }
                         t,
                    ),
                  );

                  const newTemplate FeedbackTemplate = {
                    ...template,
                    id `TPL-${Date.now()}`,
                    created formatDate(new Date()),
                    usageCount 0,
                  };
                  setTemplateList([
                    ...templateList,
                    newTemplate,
                  ]);

                setFbSubView(templates);

              onBack={() = setFbSubView(templates)}

      case settings

            title=Coming Soon
            icon=httpsimg.icons8.compulsar-color48dashboard.png

            alignItems center,

              div
                style={{
                  width 36,
                  height 36,
                  borderRadius 50%,
                  background
                    linear-gradient(135deg, #BD1313, #7A0D0D),
                  display flex,
                  alignItems center,
                  justifyContent center,
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 13,
                  fontWeight 700,
                  color white,
                  boxShadow 0 2px 8px rgba(189,19,19,0.25),
                  flexShrink 0,
                }}
              
                PS
              div
              div
                div
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 13,
                    fontWeight 600,
                    color #1A1A2E,
                  }}
                
                  Prof. Priya Sharma
                div
                div
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 11,
                    color #9898B0,
                  }}
                
                  Senior Instructor
                div
              div
            div
          div
        div

        { Screen content }
        {renderScreen()}
      div

      { ── NOTIFICATIONS PANEL ── }
      {showNotifications && (
        
          div
            style={{
              position fixed,
              inset 0,
              background rgba(26,26,46,0.3),
              backdropFilter blur(2px),
              zIndex 300,
            }}
            onClick={() = setShowNotifications(false)}
          
          div
            style={{
              position fixed,
              top 0,
              right 0,
              width 360,
              height 100vh,
              background white,
              boxShadow -8px 0 32px rgba(26,26,46,0.12),
              zIndex 301,
              display flex,
              flexDirection column,
              overflow hidden,
            }}
          
            { Panel header }
            div
              style={{
                height 56,
                background white,
                borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
                padding 0 20px,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                justifyContent space-between,
                flexShrink 0,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  display flex,
                  gap 8,
                  alignItems center,
                }}
              
                Bell size={18} color=#1A1A2E 
                span
                  style={{
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 16,
                    fontWeight 600,
                    color #1A1A2E,
                  }}
                
                  Notifications
                span
                {unreadCount  0 && (
                  span
                    style={{
                      background #BD1313,
                      color white,
                      fontFamily F,
                      fontSize 10,
                      fontWeight 700,
                      borderRadius 9999,
                      padding 2px 8px,
                    }}
                  
                    {unreadCount}
                  span
                )}
              div
              div
                style={{
                  display flex,
                  gap 8,
                  alignItems center,
                }}
              
                button
                  onClick={markAllRead}
                  style={{
                    background none,
                    border none,
                    cursor pointer,
                    fontFamily F,
                    fontSize 12,
                    color #BD1313,
                    fontWeight 500,
                    padding 0,
                  }}
                
                  Mark all read
                button
                X
                  size={18}
                  color=#4A4A68
                  style={{ cursor pointer }}
                  onClick={() = setShowNotifications(false)}
                
              div
            div

            { Notifications list }
            div
              style={{ flex 1, overflowY auto }}
              className=inner-scroll
            
              {notifList.length === 0  (
                div
                  style={{
                    display flex,
                    flexDirection column,
                    alignItems center,
                    justifyContent center,
                    height 200,
                    gap 8,
                  }}
                
                  Bell size={32} color=#EEE8E3 
                  span
                    style={{
                      fontFamily F,
                      fontSize 13,
                      color #9898B0,
                    }}
                  
                    No notifications
                  span
                div
              )  (
                notifList.map((n) = (
                  div
                    key={n.id}
                    onClick={() =
                      setNotifList((prev) =
                        prev.map((item) =
                          item.id === n.id
                             { ...item, read true }
                             item,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                    style={{
                      padding 14px 20px,
                      background !n.read  #FFFCFA  white,
                      borderBottom 1px solid #F5F0EB,
                      display flex,
                      gap 12,
                      alignItems flex-start,
                      cursor pointer,
                      transition background 0.2s,
                    }}
                  
                    div
                      style={{
                        width 36,
                        height 36,
                        borderRadius 10,
                        background notifBg(n.type),
                        display flex,
                        alignItems center,
                        justifyContent center,
                        flexShrink 0,
                      }}
                    
                      img
                        src={notifIcon(n.type)}
                        width={18}
                        height={18}
                        alt=
                        style={{ background transparent }}
                      
                    div
                    div style={{ flex 1 }}
                      div
                        style={{
                          display flex,
                          justifyContent space-between,
                          alignItems flex-start,
                          gap 8,
                        }}
                      
                        span
                          style={{
                            fontFamily F,
                            fontSize 13,
                            fontWeight 600,
                            color !n.read
                               #1A1A2E
                               #4A4A68,
                          }}
                        
                          {n.title}
                        span
                        span
                          style={{
                            fontFamily F,
                            fontSize 10,
                            color #9898B0,
                            flexShrink 0,
                          }}
                        
                          {n.time}
                        span
                      div
                      div
                        style={{
                          fontFamily F,
                          fontSize 12,
                          color #6B6B8A,
                          marginTop 2,
                          lineHeight 1.4,
                        }}
                      
                        {n.body}
                      div
                    div
                    {!n.read && (
                      div
                        style={{
                          width 8,
                          height 8,
                          borderRadius 50%,
                          background #BD1313,
                          flexShrink 0,
                          marginTop 4,
                        }}
                      
                    )}
                  div
                ))
              )}
            div

            { Panel footer }
            div
              style={{
                height 52,
                background white,
                borderTop 1px solid #EEE8E3,
                padding 0 20px,
                display flex,
                alignItems center,
                justifyContent space-between,
                flexShrink 0,
              }}
            
              span
                style={{
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 13,
                  color #6B6B8A,
                  cursor pointer,
                }}
              
                View all notifications
              span
              span
                style={{
                  fontFamily F,
                  fontSize 13,
                  color #DC2626,
                  fontWeight 500,
                  cursor pointer,
                }}
                onClick={() = setNotifList([])}
              
                Clear all
              span
            div
          div
        
      )}

      { ── TOASTS ── }
      div
        style={{
          position fixed,
          top 16,
          left 50%,
          transform translateX(-50%),
          zIndex 9999,
          display flex,
          flexDirection column,
          gap 8,
          pointerEvents none,
        }}
      
        {toasts.map((toast) = (
          div
            key={toast.id}
            style={{
              background #1A1A2E,
              color white,
              fontFamily F,
              fontSize 13,
              fontWeight 500,
              padding 12px 20px,
              borderRadius 9999,
              boxShadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.14),
              display flex,
              gap 8,
              alignItems center,
              animation toastEnter 350ms ease-out both,
            }}
          
            {toast.type === success && (
              CheckCircle size={16} color=#16A34A 
            )}
            {toast.type === error && (
              XCircle size={16} color=#DC2626 
            )}
            {toast.type === warning && (
              AlertTriangle size={16} color=#D97706 
            )}
            {toast.type === default && (
              Info size={16} color=#9898B0 
            )}
            {toast.message}
          div
        ))}
      div

      { ── COURSE PIPELINE MODALS ── }
      {showLockModal && (
        LockModal
          course={selectedPipelineCourse}
          onClose={() = setShowLockModal(false)}
          onConfirm={() = {
            if (selectedPipelineCourse) {
              setCourseList((prev) =
                prev.map((c) =
                  c.id === selectedPipelineCourse.id
                     {
                        ...c,
                        status locked as const,
                        pipelineStage 1,
                      }
                     c,
                ),
              );
              setShowLockModal(false);
              setCourseSubView(upload-assets);
              showToast(
                Course locked successfully,
                success,
              );
            }
          }}
        
      )}
      {showPublishModal && (
        PublishModal
          course={selectedPipelineCourse}
          onClose={() = setShowPublishModal(false)}
          onConfirm={() = {
            if (selectedPipelineCourse) {
              setCourseList((prev) =
                prev.map((c) =
                  c.id === selectedPipelineCourse.id
                     {
                        ...c,
                        status published as const,
                        pipelineStage 5,
                      }
                     c,
                ),
              );
              setShowPublishModal(false);
              setCourseSubView(library);
              setCourseLibraryTab(published);
              showToast(
                🎉 Course published successfully!,
                success,
              );
            }
          }}
        
      )}

      { ── LOGOUT MODAL ── }
      {showLogoutModal && (
        div
          style={{
            position fixed,
            inset 0,
            background rgba(26,26,46,0.5),
            backdropFilter blur(4px),
            zIndex 500,
            display flex,
            alignItems center,
            justifyContent center,
          }}
          onClick={() = setShowLogoutModal(false)}
        
          div
            onClick={(e) = e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{
              background white,
              borderRadius 20,
              width 400,
              boxShadow 0 20px 60px rgba(26,26,46,0.18),
              overflow hidden,
            }}
          
            div
              style={{
                padding 24,
                borderBottom 1px solid #EEE8E3,
                display flex,
                gap 12,
                alignItems center,
              }}
            
              div
                style={{
                  width 44,
                  height 44,
                  borderRadius 12,
                  background #FEF2F2,
                  display flex,
                  alignItems center,
                  justifyContent center,
                }}
              
                svg
                  width=22
                  height=22
                  viewBox=0 0 24 24
                  fill=none
                  stroke=#DC2626
                  strokeWidth=2
                  strokeLinecap=round
                  strokeLinejoin=round
                
                  path d=M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4 
                  polyline points=16 17 21 12 16 7 
                  line x1=21 y1=12 x2=9 y2=12 
                svg
              div
              div
                div
                  style={{
                    fontSize 16,
                    fontWeight 700,
                    color #1A1A2E,
                    fontFamily F,
                  }}
                
                  Sign Out
                div
                div
                  style={{
                    fontSize 13,
                    color #9898B0,
                    marginTop 2,
                    fontFamily F,
                  }}
                
                  You'll be redirected to the login page
                div
              div
            div
            div
              style={{
                padding 16px 24px,
                fontSize 13,
                color #4A4A68,
                lineHeight 1.6,
                fontFamily F,
              }}
            
              Your session will end and any unsaved changes will
              be lost. Are you sure you want to sign out of
              LearningVision
            div
            div
              style={{
                padding 0 24px 24px,
                display flex,
                gap 12,
                justifyContent flex-end,
              }}
            
              button
                onClick={() = setShowLogoutModal(false)}
                style={{
                  height 44,
                  padding 0 20px,
                  background transparent,
                  border 1.5px solid #EEE8E3,
                  borderRadius 10,
                  fontSize 14,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  color #4A4A68,
                  cursor pointer,
                  fontFamily F,
                }}
              
                Cancel
              button
              button
                onClick={() = {
                  setShowLogoutModal(false);
                  showToast(
                    Signed out successfully,
                    success,
                  );
                }}
                style={{
                  height 44,
                  padding 0 20px,
                  background #DC2626,
                  color white,
                  border none,
                  borderRadius 10,
                  fontSize 14,
                  fontWeight 600,
                  cursor pointer,
                  fontFamily F,
                }}
              
                Sign Out
              button
            div
          div
        div
      )}
    div
  );
}
